title: Head Of Product Marketing
description:
****About CertifyOS****
 CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.
   

  

 Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.
   

  

 Our API\-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.
   

  

 Our vision is simple:
 **One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.**
 We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high\-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 We are seeking a Head of Research, Competitive Intelligence \& Product Marketing to own market intelligence, pricing strategy, product portfolio optimization, and go\-to\-market execution for Certify's Provider Data Management platform. This is a high\-impact, cross\-functional role at the intersection of strategy, data, and commercialization — built for someone who can turn raw market signals into clear, revenue\-driving decisions
 *and* 
 translate those decisions into compelling market narratives that move buyers.
   

  

 You will be the connective tissue between what the market demands and how Certify goes to market — owning not just the intelligence and strategy, but the activation of that strategy through product marketing, sales enablement, and positioning. This role is as much about execution as it is about insight.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 We are seeking a Head of Product Marketing to own market intelligence, pricing strategy, product portfolio optimization, and go\-to\-market execution for Certify's Provider Data Management platform. This is a high\-impact, cross\-functional role at the intersection of strategy, data, and commercialization — built for someone who can turn raw market signals into clear, revenue\-driving decisions
 *and* 
 translate those decisions into compelling market narratives that move buyers.
   

  

 You will be the connective tissue between what the market demands and how Certify goes to market — owning not just the intelligence and strategy, but the activation of that strategy through product marketing, sales enablement, and positioning. This role is as much about execution as it is about insight.
   

  

****What You'll Do:****
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Research
* Own end\-to\-end competitive intelligence for the Provider Data Management (PDM) space — tracking competitor positioning, product roadmaps, pricing moves, and win/loss patterns.
* Build and maintain a continuous market monitoring system — synthesizing signals from analyst reports, customer interviews, sales conversations, and public filings into a living intelligence database.
* Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly market reports with clear insights and recommended actions for product, sales, and leadership — including building AI\-driven architecture to automate reporting workflows.
* Conduct regular primary research (customer interviews, prospect calls, win/loss debriefs) to pressure\-test hypotheses and surface ground\-truth insights that secondary research can't provide.
* Pricing Strategy \& Revenue Optimization
* Develop and own Certify's pricing strategy across all products and segments — balancing customer value, competitive dynamics, and revenue growth objectives.
* Model pricing scenarios for new products, expansions, and enterprise deals — providing finance and sales with clear pricing frameworks that maximize deal velocity without leaving revenue on the table.
* Design and test pricing experiments (e.g., value\-based vs. usage\-based models) informed by customer willingness\-to\-pay data, cohort analysis, and market benchmarks.
* Product Portfolio \& Packaging Optimization
* Evaluate and optimize Certify's product portfolio to ensure packaging, bundling, and feature prioritization align with business goals and maximize revenue per customer.
* Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities by analyzing product usage data, customer segments, and whitespace in the market — translating findings into actionable packaging recommendations.
* Monitor product performance metrics continuously and make data\-backed recommendations for improvements across pricing, packaging, and feature differentiation.
* Product Marketing \& Messaging
* This is where research meets revenue. You won't hand off insights to a separate team — you'll own the translation of market intelligence into the positioning, messaging, and content that drives pipeline and closes deals.
* Own Certify's product positioning and messaging framework — defining how each product and capability is described, differentiated, and sold across all buyer segments and personas.
* Develop and maintain a full library of sales and marketing assets: battlecards, one\-pagers, solution briefs, case studies, pitch decks, ROI calculators, and objection\-handling guides — built from your own research and updated continuously as the market evolves.
* Lead go\-to\-market launches for new products, features, and packaging changes — coordinating with Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure launches land with clarity and drive measurable adoption.
* Build and own Certify's buyer persona library — deeply understanding the motivations, objections, evaluation criteria, and success metrics of key decision\-makers (health plan medical directors, credentialing ops leaders, procurement, IT, etc.).
* Develop thought leadership content and market narratives — white papers, market sizing analyses, industry benchmarks — that position Certify as the authoritative voice in the PDM space and support demand generation efforts.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is grounded in validated market intelligence and resonates with target segments — bridging the gap between data and creative execution.
* Support demand generation by identifying the highest\-value market segments and building the research\-backed targeting rationale that informs campaign strategy and ABM prioritization.
* Product Team Integration \& Roadmap Influence
* This role has a uniquely close relationship with the Product team — functioning as the market\-facing counterpart to Product's internal\-facing focus. Where Product owns the what and how of the platform, you own the why and for whom — and the two must be deeply integrated.
* Serve as the primary voice of the market inside product planning — bringing customer research, competitive data, and market sizing into roadmap discussions to ensure investment flows toward the highest\-value opportunities.
* Co\-own the product discovery process with Product leadership — designing and running customer research programs (user interviews, surveys, advisory boards) that generate the qualitative and quantitative signals needed to prioritize effectively.
* Translate product capabilities into market\-ready value propositions for every significant release — working hand\-in\-hand with Product Managers to ensure new features land with clear messaging, adoption materials, and sales training.
* Maintain a continuous feedback loop between Sales, Customer Success, and Product — capturing field intelligence, win/loss themes, and customer sentiment and synthesizing it into structured quarterly product input reports.
* Define and track product marketing KPIs — feature adoption rates, enablement utilization, message resonance scores — and use these to continuously refine positioning and packaging recommendations.


****What Success Looks Like****
* Market Intelligence Velocity: Weekly competitive briefings delivered to leadership; automated reporting pipeline live within 90 days.
* Pricing Impact: Measurable improvement in ACV and win rates within 6 months of pricing strategy implementation; ≥2 pricing model updates per year informed by data.
* Portfolio Clarity: 100% of product lines have a documented packaging and tiering rationale; portfolio reviewed and updated quarterly.
* GTM Enablement: Competitive battlecards and pricing guides maintained for 100% of active competitors; ≥80% of sales reps rating intelligence materials as highly useful in quarterly surveys.
* Product Marketing Coverage: Full positioning and messaging framework documented and live within 60 days; all major product releases launched with complete go\-to\-market packages.
* Revenue Contribution: Research insights directly traceable to at least two new revenue\-generating initiatives per year, including upsell opportunities or new segment entry.


****What You’ll Need:****
**Must\-Have Experience**
* 5–8\+ years in competitive intelligence, market research, pricing strategy, or product strategy in a SaaS or technology\-driven industry.
* Demonstrated track record developing and deploying pricing models that improved win rates, ACV, or NRR in a B2B context.
* Strong analytical skills — fluent in data and able to independently build financial models, analyze usage data, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals into crisp recommendations.
* Background in healthcare SaaS, health plan operations, or provider data — familiarity with credentialing, network management, or regulatory compliance a strong plus.
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams (Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing) and drive strategic decisions without direct authority.
* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills — able to distill complex market dynamics into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and board\-level audiences.


****Preferred Experience****
* Experience building or scaling a competitive intelligence function from scratch, including designing research processes, tooling, and reporting cadences.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools to accelerate research workflows — e.g., automated monitoring, LLM\-powered analysis, or data aggregation pipelines.
* Familiarity with usage\-based or value\-based pricing models, willingness\-to\-pay research methods, or conjoint analysis.


**Our Research \& Culture Principles**
* Ground Truth First: No insight without validation. You talk to customers, prospects, and the market — you don’t just read reports.
* Insight to Action: Research without a recommended action is incomplete. You close the loop between intelligence and business impact.
* Low Ego, High Standards: Nothing is beneath you — you dive into the data, own the details, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.
* Prioritize Relentlessly: The market generates infinite signals. You know which ones matter and focus your energy accordingly.
* Deliver A\+ Work: “Good enough” is not our bar. The quality of your research reflects on Certify’s credibility with customers, investors, and partners.


****Benefits Of Working At Certify****
* At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.
* Your well\-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US\-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.


 We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.
   

  

 We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.

description:
**About Organization: Join the Charge. Create the Future.** 




 At Ultraviolette, we're more than a company—we’re a movement. A movement that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible in electric mobility. From engineering India’s Fastest Motorcycle to designing The World’s Most Advanced Electric Scooter, we thrive on innovation, audacity, and the relentless pursuit of performance.
 



 We’re a diverse team of trailblazers, engineers, designers, creatives and visionaries—united by a shared obsession: to craft machines that are not only sustainable but exhilarating. Here, radical design meets intelligent technology, and every line of code or bolt of hardware brings us closer to reshaping the future of mobility.
 



 Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of mobility across the globe \- and we’re just getting started.
 



 If you're driven by purpose, inspired by possibility, and ready to build something that truly matters, Ultraviolette is the place where your ambition becomes impact. Let's create the future—together.
 



  





**Job responsibilities:** 




**Market Strategy Development \& Execution:** 



* Design and implement comprehensive marketing strategies for the 2\-wheeler EV segment in international markets, focusing on growth, market penetration, and brand awareness.
* Analyse market trends, customer behaviour, and competitor activity in target regions to identify opportunities and tailor strategies for specific markets.
* Develop marketing campaigns that resonate with local cultural, economic, and regulatory contexts to increase adoption of electric two\-wheelers.



**Product Positioning \& Branding:** 



* Drive the creation of compelling product positioning and brand messaging tailored for international markets, focusing on the sustainability, innovation, and cost\-efficiency of electric two\-wheelers.
* Collaborate with product teams to ensure marketing strategies align with product features, benefits, and unique selling propositions.
* Ensure consistency in brand messaging across all international campaigns, aligning with the overall corporate vision.



**International Campaign Management:** 



* Plan, execute, and optimize 360\-degree marketing campaigns, including digital advertising, social media engagement, influencer partnerships, events, and PR initiatives.
* Oversee global product launch campaigns, working with local marketing teams to ensure successful execution in different regions.
* Leverage both online and offline marketing channels to maximize visibility and drive customer engagement.



**Market Research \& Competitive Analysis:** 



* Conduct regular market research to stay informed about evolving consumer preferences, competitive landscape, and emerging trends in the electric vehicle industry.
* Perform competitor analysis to identify opportunities for differentiation, product innovation, and brand positioning.
* Gather consumer insights to guide product development, communication strategies, and marketing decisions.



**Strategic Partnerships \& Collaborations:** 



* Establish and maintain relationships with key international stakeholders such as distributors, dealers, local influencers, media, and government bodies to drive market growth.
* Explore and negotiate partnerships with local entities (e.g., retailers, charging station providers) to enhance product accessibility and customer experience.



**Budget Management \& ROI Analysis:** 



* Manage marketing budgets efficiently to ensure optimal allocation of resources across different channels and campaigns.
* Track and analyse key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of marketing efforts, ensuring maximum ROI.
* Provide regular reports and updates to senior management on campaign performance, insights, and recommendations.



**Team Collaboration:** 



* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including sales, product, technical, and finance to align marketing efforts with overall business goals.



  





**Education:** 



* Master’s degree in Business Management, Marketing, Sales or international business

title: Senior Associate - Enterprise & Functional Strategy – Marketing Strategy
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate \- Enterprise \& Functional Strategy – Marketing Strategy, you will provide strategic guidance and insights to organizations, analyzing market trends and assessing business performance to develop recommendations that help clients achieve their goals. Within our Strategy Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to identify growth opportunities, optimize operations, and enhance overall business performance. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills.  In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will analyze client needs and provide consulting services across different strategic areas. You will offer guidance and support to help clients develop and implement effective strategies that align with their business objectives and drive growth. This position offers a unique opportunity to deepen your understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts and interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.

* Excelling in critical thinking and problem\-solving

title: Senior Strategic Operations Analyst, Marketing
description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.
   

  

 Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.\-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.
   

  

 We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and Senior Strategic Operation Analyst to own recurring reporting needs that support the marketing analytics team and help turn data into action. Reporting to the Strategic Operations Analytics Manager, this role will manage recurring reporting workflows, dashboard refreshes, campaign reporting and lead data hygiene so the analytics team can focus on insight generation, executive storytelling and recommendations. This role sits within the Office of the CEO, as the Chief of Staff to the CEO leads the strategy operations group.
   

  

 Senior Strategic Operation Analyst closely with Marketing Analytics, Sales Operations, Finance, Demand Generation, ABM, and Events to ensure reporting is accurate, timely and standardized across the marketing organization. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across systems, is highly organized and takes pride in operational excellence and precision.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Weekly Pipeline Reporting: Produce and maintain weekly pipeline reporting for marketing leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, consistency and timely delivery.
* Monthly CMO Dashboard: Support the monthly CMO dashboard and related leadership reporting with refreshed metrics, explanations and supporting detail.
* Digital Campaign Reporting: Build and update digital campaign dashboards and reports across email, paid media, web, ABM and demand generation programs.
* ABM Campaign Reporting: Maintain ABM campaign dashboards and reporting to help measure account engagement, conversion and pipeline contribution.
* Event Campaign Reporting: Create and maintain event campaign reports for webinars, field events, customer summits and other integrated marketing programs.
* Product Line Engagement Dashboards: Update and manage product line engagement dashboards to provide visibility into audience engagement and program performance.
* Power BI Refreshes: Own daily Power BI dashboard refreshes and ensure reporting outputs are available, reliable and easy to access for stakeholders.
* Lead Hygiene and Reminders: Send weekly reminders to sales for leads stuck in NEW status and coordinate with MDRs on follow\-up.
* Lead Data Enrichment: Support daily and weekly lead data enrichment by completing missing information, applying tags and improving reporting completeness.
* Reporting Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline reporting workflows, reduce manual work and improve the consistency of recurring outputs.
* Cross\-Functional Support: Partner with marketing analytics, sales operations, finance and demand generation teams to ensure reporting needs are aligned and delivered on time.


**Qualifications**
* 3–7 years of experience in marketing operations, reporting, analytics or related business operations roles.
* Strong working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, dashboarding and reporting tools such as Salesforce, Power BI, Excel and marketing automation platforms.
* Excellent attention to detail with a track record of producing accurate, timely and reliable reporting.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage recurring work across multiple stakeholders.
* Comfort working in a high\-growth, matrixed global organization with diverse reporting needs.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to translate data requests into clear, repeatable reporting outputs.
* Experience supporting weekly and monthly leadership reporting is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, analytics, finance or a related field preferred.


**Success Profile**
* Highly organized and dependable
* Naturally detail\-oriented
* Comfortable balancing speed with accuracy
* Proactive in following up and closing reporting gaps
* Collaborative and service\-oriented


 Sphera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all colleagues.
   

  

 This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position.

title: Senior Director - Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
**Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion\+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path from here is fluid:** 
 all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P\&L ownership. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress\-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi\-million\-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



  





 This role exists to convert a multi\-million\-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day\-to\-day executive involvement.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes:** 
 A multi\-million\-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non\-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.



  




* **Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions:** 
 Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day\-to\-day executive oversight.



  





**The Career Accelerator:** 




 This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce** 
 : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.



  





**What Is In It For You:** 




 This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You** 




 You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.
 



  




* You allocate multi\-million\-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform\-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.
* You hold profitability to a contribution\-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign\-off, reporting directly to the CEO.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 



* 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
* 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
* 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire** 




 In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need:** 



* 7\+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M\+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
* Google depth at PMax\-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non\-brand economics.
* High\-AOV considered\-purchase experience ($1,000\+ order values): sparse\-conversion, long\-decision\-cycle categories.
* Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
* Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false\-kill vs. wasted\-spend trade\-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
* Creative testing systems at scale in a post\-ATT environment: concept\-vs\-variation discipline, creative analytics.
* Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
* Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.



  





**Good\-to\-Have:** 



* Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
* Mixed agency \+ in\-house background.
* Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
* D2C e\-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high\-AOV verticals.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* 💰
 **Compensation:** 
 Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)



 Annual salary review every January
 


* 🏥
 **Health \& Protection:** 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
* 🌴
 **Time Off:** 
 Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public holidays



  





 💼
 **Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning \& development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16\+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.



  





**🏆 Rewards \& Recognition:** 



* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions



  





**Ready to Shape Your Story?** 




 Click "Apply" and take the first step.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:

 **Performance Marketing Executive** 
 to support execution across

 This is a hands\-on role for someone strong in execution, reporting, and working with data. You will help manage campaigns, track performance, prepare reports, and support fast testing cycles across accounts.

* Follow SOPs and contribute to building better internal processes
* Work in a structured manner with attention to detail
* Coordinate smoothly with internal team members on execution and reporting requirements

* **Minimum 6 months of hands\-on experience in performance marketing (mandatory)**

* **Meta Ads \& Google Ads**
* **Very good in Excel / Google Sheets (mandatory)**
* Familiarity with
 **AI tools** 
 and comfort using them in day\-to\-day work

* Exposure to D2C or lead generation accounts
* Comfort working in fast\-paced testing environments



  





**Cultural Fit** 




 You’ll be the right fit if you are:
 


* **Execution\-focused:** 
 You like getting things done properly and on time
* **Detail\-oriented:** 
 You care about data accuracy, tracking, and clean reporting
* **Process\-friendly:** 
 You believe good work needs structure and discipline
* **Tool\-curious:** 
 You are open to learning and using AI tools to improve output
* **Reliable:** 
 You can be trusted to execute consistently without chaos



  





**Not a Fit If** 



* You have not independently executed campaigns on both Meta and Google
* You are weak in reporting or not comfortable with Excel/Sheets
* You do not enjoy detailed execution work
* You dislike process, documentation, and structured ways of working
* You need constant follow\-up to get tasks done

title: Digital & Performance Marketing Associate
description:
**About Circled Advisory** 




  





 Circled Advisory is building Circled Plus, Bangalore's first invite\-only private listing platform for luxury homes, along with Circled Intelligence (CI), our proprietary pricing and decision engine designed to help buyers understand what a property is actually worth and make more informed buying decisions.
 



 We advise founders, CXOs, business owners, HNIs, and UHNIs on some of the city's most exclusive residential opportunities. Our approach is built on trust, market intelligence, discretion, and long\-term relationships not transactional selling.
 



 We're a small, ambitious team building a new standard for luxury real estate advisory in Bangalore.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore – HBR Layout
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years of hands\-on digital/performance marketing experience. Experience in real estate or at a digital marketing agency handling real estate clients is a plus.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on digital marketer who can
 **execute, analyse, and solve problems** 
 not someone who simply completes assigned tasks.
 



 You will work closely with our Digital Marketing Head across performance marketing, analytics, CRM, automation, creatives, content, and website performance.
 



  





 We want someone who naturally asks:
 **Why did performance drop? Where are leads leaking? Is tracking working correctly? What should we test or change next?** 




  





 You don't need to know every platform we use from Day 1\. But you should have strong digital marketing fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to figure things out.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Execute and optimise campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other digital channels
* Track CPL, CTR, CPC, conversions, lead quality, and overall funnel performance
* Analyse campaign data and turn insights into clear actions, experiments, and improvements
* Use Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to understand traffic, user behaviour, drop\-offs, and conversion issues
* Monitor the journey from campaign → website → lead → CRM → engagement and identify potential leakages
* Work with CRM and automation platforms such as Sell.Do, AiSensy, Brevo, CallerDesk, and Pabbly
* Support WhatsApp marketing, email marketing, social media engagement, and customer databases
* Create and adapt campaign creatives and social content using Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools
* Support basic video/reel editing where required
* Support website blogs, LinkedIn content, SEO, backlinks, and landing\-page improvements
* Identify tracking, integration, or workflow issues and coordinate with developers or vendors to resolve them
* Continuously look for ways to make our digital marketing systems simpler, faster, and more effective



  





**Who You Are** 




  




* 1–3 years of hands\-on digital or performance marketing experience
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Meta Ads and/or Google Ads**
* Strong understanding of
 **CPL, CTR, CPC, conversions, lead quality, and digital funnels**
* Working knowledge of
 **Google Analytics or similar analytics tools**
* Working knowledge of
 **Canva, Photoshop, or similar creative tools**
* Familiar with CRM, automation, and lead\-management workflows
* Able to turn data into actions rather than simply preparing reports
* Naturally curious — when something isn't working, you want to understand why
* Comfortable taking ownership without waiting for detailed instructions
* Comfortable learning new platforms and solving digital issues independently
* Organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a small, fast\-paced startup environment



  





**Most importantly, we are looking for someone who notices problems before being asked to look for them.** 




  





**Why Join Circled** 



* Work across the complete digital marketing funnel — campaigns, analytics, CRM, automation, creatives, and website
* Your ideas can move from discussion to live execution quickly
* High ownership with room to experiment, learn, and solve real marketing problems
* Work closely with the Digital Marketing Head and leadership team
* Opportunity to grow into independently owning campaigns and larger parts of the digital marketing function
* Small team, direct founder exposure, and zero unnecessary corporate layers



  





**Other Details** 



* **Work Location:** 
 HBR Layout, Bangalore
* **Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday



 Share your profile at
 **anush@circled.co.in**

title: Sales And Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 FlexAbility Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Clinic is a leading physiotherapy and sports rehabilitation center focused on expert care and personalized recovery solutions. Founded to redefine physiotherapy services in India, FlexAbility blends clinical excellence, advanced techniques, and a compassionate approach to help individuals recover faster and move more confidently. With branches in key Bengaluru locations such as Koramangala and Jayanagar, the clinic specializes in sports injuries, post\-surgical rehabilitation, musculoskeletal pain, neurological conditions, and related concerns. Highly trained physiotherapists design customized treatment plans tailored to each person’s needs and goals. FlexAbility is driven by a mission to empower people in their recovery journey and to set new benchmarks in patient experience and results\-driven therapy for individuals, athletes, and healthcare professionals.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales and Marketing Specialist role based in Bengaluru. The specialist will develop and implement sales and marketing activities to increase clinic awareness, patient inquiries, and service utilization. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include engaging with prospective and existing patients, handling walk\-in and phone inquiries, and promoting services through presentations, local outreach, and partnerships with gyms, sports clubs, and healthcare providers. The role involves supporting digital and offline campaigns, coordinating promotional events, and maintaining accurate records of leads, conversions, and feedback. The specialist will collaborate closely with clinic leadership and therapists to align messaging with clinical offerings and ensure a consistent, patient\-centered brand experience.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, including clear verbal and written communication.
* Candidates should possess customer service skills to manage inquiries, build trust, and support a positive patient experience.
* Candidates should possess sales and sales management skills to drive conversions, manage pipelines, and meet growth targets.
* Candidates should possess training and presentation skills to conduct workshops, information sessions, and partner education.
* Relevant experience in healthcare, wellness, sports, or service\-based businesses is beneficial.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru, manage multiple tasks, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Basic knowledge of digital marketing, CRM tools, and data\-driven decision\-making is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  




**Role Overview** 
  


  

 The Principal Product Manager (Marketing) exists to drive JumpCloud's market presence, packaging, and competitive positioning to accelerate global growth. In this high\-impact role, you will lead the strategic alignment of our pricing and packaging models while enabling our global sales team with the tools, positioning, and competitive insights they need to win. Serving as a key evangelist, you will translate complex platform capabilities into compelling market narratives and lead cross\-functional initiatives across sales, product, and go\-to\-market teams. Ultimately, you will solve critical business problems by elevating our thought leadership and scaling our market reach.
 




  




**Employee Value Proposition (EVP)** 
  

  
* **Purpose:** 
 You will shape how the world perceives and adopts JumpCloud’s open directory platform, directly influencing our market share and driving modern identity infrastructure solutions.
  
* **Growth:** 
 You will own major strategic pricing and packaging initiatives, expand your influence across executive\-level steering committees, and establish yourself as a premier industry speaker and evangelist.
  
* **Motivators:** 
 Work autonomously at a high\-velocity, tech\-forward company where you can leverage cutting\-edge AI tools to build processes and drive sales acceleration assets that directly impact revenue.
  

  


  


  




**Major Performance Objectives** 
  


 Measurable outcomes for the first 6\-12 months:
 


  

  
* **6\-Month Integration \& Asset Delivery:** 
 Within the first 6 months, fully integrate into the marketing and product teams to deliver at least 3 high\-value assets and incorporate JumpCloud's thought leadership and positioning across key marketing channels.
  
* **Pricing \& Packaging Strategy:** 
 Within 9 months, analyze, optimize, and roll out an updated pricing and packaging strategy that simplifies customer onboarding and maximizes average contract value (ACV).
  
* **Sales Enablement \& Competitive Differentiation:** 
 By month 12, equip the global sales organization with comprehensive competitive differentiators and positioning assets, resulting in increased win rates against key competitors.
  
* **Platform Evangelism \& Thought Leadership:**

description:
**Description**
 Amazon Prime is a program that provides millions of members with unlimited FREE same day, one\-day delivery, unlimited streaming of video and music, secure online photo storage, access to kindle e\-books as well as Prime offers on Prime Day. In emerging markets like India and other locales, Prime members get delivery benefits, video streaming, music streaming and early and exclusive access to deals. Over the years, Prime has continuously added value as well as increased flexibility in options for customers to join Prime. To continue to drive member acquisition via marketing channels, emerging markets Prime team is now looking for a talented, enthusiastic Senior Marketing Manager, who is excited about growing this strategic program further. We require a Senior Marketing Manager (MM) to drive the communication strategy for Prime plans. This MM will work on driving the vision for surfacing Prime plans across key Prime upsell locations. This MM will partner with channel teams to drive adoption of Prime plans. In addition, MM will partner to drive strategy during events for Prime Early access for member growth and liaise with categories to execute innovative marketing and merchandising initiatives to drive Prime member acquisition.
   

  

 The role will require working with local and international teams, managing expectations and dependencies with multiple stakeholders. The ideal candidate will need to be detail\-oriented and organized, have strong creative skills, capable of handling multiple projects and priorities at once, comfortable with ambiguity. The candidate will be able to synthesize business objectives into rapidly and flawlessly execute high quality marketing programs, past experience with funnel optimization, content experimentation is a plus. Besides having first\-class written/verbal communication skills, the MM will need to be able to see and show results with data \- understanding customer behavior and across different customer cohorts through analytics is critical to success and SQL abilities will be plus.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* MBA with 6\+ years of Product Marketing experience.
* Owns marketing strategy and execution for the business and product portfolio to drive adoption and scale.
* Works with internal teams to jointly define, develop, execute and analyze high\-impact go\-to\-market digital and physical channel marketing strategies merchandising, promotion, customer value propositions, messaging, campaign goals and measurement.
* Develop an understanding of the drivers of customer acquisition and translate those insights into go\-to\-market programs, campaigns and promotions.
* Executes campaigns leveraging the full range of merchandising vehicles available, using data, analysis and best practices to optimize your decisions and maximize ROI.
* Works internally with Business Development, PR, Product Management, Research, Brand marketing , Legal, Retail marketing teams to ensure internal cross\-functional alignment.
* Reporting on success metrics related to acquisition


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross\-functional marketing programs

title: APAC Business Marketing Manager, AI Ecosystem
description:
At Meta, we believe AI transforms how people and businesses connect and grow. Our mission is to enable and inspire developers to build with Meta's AI models and new monetization businesses, cultivating a thriving AI Ecosystem grounded in innovation and trust.We're seeking a Business Marketing Manager for AI Ecosystem to grow the awareness, adoption, and sentiment of Meta's AI models and new monetization businesses with developers across the ecosystem including individual builders, startups, enterprises, and industry associations, spanning APAC's diverse markets. This role spans developers, ecosystem partners, and enterprise audiences, and it requires both a technical lens on AI models and demonstrated marketing acumen, from strategy through execution. You'll own the APAC go\-to\-market plan, combining day\-to\-day operational execution with longer\-term strategic planning.
   

  

 APAC Business Marketing Manager, AI Ecosystem Responsibilities:
   

  

* Build and execute the AI developer marketing strategy for APAC to deliver on Meta's goal of having the most widely adopted AI models and products in the world
* Own the localized go\-to\-market plan: translate global launches and product\-sourced narratives into locally resonant activations that address developer jobs\-to\-be\-done across APAC priority markets
* Turn technical messaging, assets, and documentation into developer\-ready content — blogs, videos, tutorials, demos, events, and solution guides — tailored to local audiences
* Drive the hybrid GTM motion across developers, partners, and enterprise: equip ecosystem partners, cloud providers, and enterprise engineering teams with the technical narrative and assets they need
* Plan and execute developer\-first programs: hackathons, workshops, technical conference presence, community engagement, and digital campaigns
* Work directly with developers, partners, and customers across APAC to pressure\-test messaging, gather feedback, and channel technical requirements back to product and engineering
* Use adoption data, developer funnel signals, and community sentiment to guide decisions and measure performance
* establish clear operating rhythms and provide regular business and scorecard updates
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with product marketing, product and engineering, developer relations, partnerships, digital marketing, events, communications, legal, and privacy
* Manage external vendors and agencies as needed to scale content and program production


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* 10\+ years of professional experience in technology, developer/platform marketing, or B2B technology marketing in APAC
* Experience marketing technical products to a developer, ML engineering, or data science audience — including a demonstrated understanding of the developer/ML persona (workflows, tooling, evaluation criteria, pain points) and the ability to build technically credible positioning and messaging
* Working knowledge of how developers build with AI — how they evaluate models, integrate them into their stack, and deploy — across the build, fine\-tune, evaluate, and deploy lifecycle
* Experience developing technical content: tutorials, technical blog posts, videos, demos, benchmark or architecture explainers
* Experience operating across hybrid audiences: individual developers and communities, ecosystem/platform partners, and enterprise engineering organizations
* Marketing experience launching and driving adoption of new technical products in the GenAI space
* Experience working cross\-functionally with product, engineering, developer relations, research, analytics, and digital marketing
* Experience using data to measure adoption and sentiment and optimize outcomes within a measurable framework
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, marketing, business, analytics, or a related discipline
* AI\-native across the marketing workflow: uses AI tools as default practice for planning, operations, research, campaign production and reporting


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with developer\-led or product\-led growth, and measuring developer funnel signals (downloads, API calls, repository activity, retention)
* Experience engaging maintainer and contributor communities
* Active member of the AI Ecosystem and developer community, with contributions, technical writing, or conference speaking
* Experience implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality/accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with the APAC developer ecosystem — including startups, enterprises, and government agencies
* Professional fluency in one or more regional languages (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese, or Hindi) is a plus because the role requires direct engagement with developers, partners, and customers in local APAC markets where business is conducted in the local language


 About Meta:
   

  

 Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
   

  

 Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

**Growth Manager – Karnataka** 




**Location: BLR** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**About Namma Yatri \& Bharat taxi** 




  





 Namma Yatri, built and operated by Moving Tech, is the tech and strategy partner for Bharat Taxi. Namma Yatri, the world's largest open mobility platform, runs community\-led mobility platforms like Namma Yatri (Bengaluru), Yatri Sathi (Kolkata), Chennai One, Odisha Yatri, and Kerala Savari, and is now powering Bharat Taxi with the same open, people\-ﬁrst DNA. These platforms, pioneers of a zero\-commission, SaaS model, have completed 130M\+ trips with driver earnings of over ₹2,200 Cr.
 



  





 Bharat Taxi aims to be the Amul for Mobility \- a people\-ﬁrst, cooperative\-based taxi initiative backed by the Central Government Ministry of Cooperation that offers safe, affordable, and digniﬁed mobility at scale. It brings drivers together on a common platform so they can earn fairly while serving riders with trust and transparency.
 



  





 Together, Bharat Taxi and Namma Yatri are building a multi\-city, multi\-modal mobility network that serves Samaaj (society), Sarkar (government), and Bazaar (business), aligned with open digital public infrastructure.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a high\-ownership Growth Manager to drive growth, supply expansion,
 



 operational excellence, and conversion improvements across Karnataka.
 



  





 This role sits at the intersection of Ops, Product, Growth, and Analytics. The ideal candidate
 



 should be extremely strong with numbers, operational problem\-solving, and cross\-functional
 



 execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Supply\-Led Growth \& Marketplace Management** 




 ● Drive supply growth and marketplace efficiency across cities
 



 ● Own key supply metrics including active drivers, online hours, conversion, cancellations, utilisation, and subscription realisation
 



 ● Identify and solve demand\-supply gaps through structured interventions
 



  





**Conversion \& Funnel Optimisation** 




 ● Improve conversion metrics across search → booking → completed rides
 



 ● Work closely with Product teams to improve user journeys and reduce friction points
 



 ● Coordinate with Marketing teams on top\-of\-the\-funnel growth and conversion efficiency
 



  





**Data \& Experimentation** 




 ● Build dashboards, track cohorts, identify trends, and derive actionable insights
 



 ● Run structured experiments across pricing, supply, and engagement levers
 



  





**Operations \& Execution Excellence** 




 ● Build scalable operational playbooks and improve execution reliability
 



 ● Solve operational bottlenecks with speed and ownership
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  





 ● Strong problem solving and structured thinking
 



 ● Comfort with data \- dashboards, metrics, decision\-making from numbers
 



 ● Experience in product, program management, consulting, account management
 



 ● Experience working with tech and engineering teams
 



 ● Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
 



 ● High ownership, bias to action, and comfort with ambiguity
 



 ● Interest in impact, mobility, public good, and driver empowerment
 



 ● High on empathy and EQ to balance priorities of multiple stakeholders
 



  





**Bonus Points** 




 ● MBA from top tier B school
 



 ● Experience in mobility, community\-led initiatives, cooperatives, public transport, government programs, or platform businesses
 



 ● Experience launching or scaling products in new cities or regions

title: Brand Manager, Kitchen, Kitchen

title: Head of Brand
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a brand builder not a brand manager. Someone who can take a consumer insight and turn it into a brand that people feel something about. You will own a brand end\-to\-end at Meolaa, from positioning and product to packaging, content, and commercial performance. This is a P\&L role as much as it is a creative one. You will be expected to think like a founder, move like an operator, and obsess like a consumer.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 Brand Strategy \& Positioning
 



  





 Own the brand's identity, voice, and long\-term positioning in the market
 



 Translate consumer insights into sharp, differentiated brand narratives
 



 Define and protect the brand's whitespace what it stands for and what it doesn't
 



 Lead packaging, design, and product brief development in collaboration with creative and category teams
 



  





 P\&L \& Commercial Ownership
 



  





 Own the brand P\&L revenue, margins, and contribution
 



 Drive pricing strategy, discount governance, and promotional planning
 



 Work closely with the Finance team on unit economics, AOP, and monthly performance tracking
 



 Identify growth levers and allocate resources to maximise ROI across channels
 



  





 Product \& Category
 



  





 Lead new product development and launch end\-to\-end from brief to shelf
 



 Identify category whitespace and build a pipeline of innovation
 



 Own the product portfolio architecture what to build, what to scale, what to kill
 



  





 Go\-to\-Market \& Growth
 



  





 Partner with the Growth and Performance teams to drive acquisition, retention, and repeat
 



 Own the brand's presence across e\-commerce marketplaces, D2C website, and emerging channels
 



 Lead content strategy and campaign development ensure every touchpoint is on\-brand and on\-brief
 



  





 Consumer \& Market Intelligence
 



  





 Stay deeply connected to the consumer qualitative and quantitative
 



 Track competitive landscape, emerging trends, and category shifts
 



 Use data to make decisions, not just to report on them
 



  





  





**Who You Are** 




  





 7–12 years of experience in brand management, with strong exposure to D2C, FMCG, or consumer startups
 



 Has built or scaled a brand from early stage not just managed a mature one
 



 Strong creative sensibility combined with sharp commercial instincts
 



 Comfortable owning a P\&L and having hard conversations about performance
 



 Has worked across product, marketing, and growth not siloed in one function
 



 Excellent communication can write a brand brief as confidently as a business case
 



 High ownership, builder mindset, low need for hand\-holding
 



  





  





**Why This Role** 




  





 Full ownership of a brand from day one
 



 Work directly with the Founders on strategy and portfolio decisions
 



 Opportunity to build something that genuinely stands for something
 



 Competitive compensation with meaningful upside as the brand scales

title: SE_Feature Specialist_Senior Expert
description:
**Description**
 Digital Lifecycle Strategist at Strategic Product Planning
   

  

 Together with our customers and supply chain partners, governments, societies and other stakeholders, we are moving to develop and introduce transport and infrastructure solutions that drive prosperity socially, environmentally and financially.
   

  

 The shift to software\-defined vehicles (SDV) is fundamentally reshaping the automotive industry. At Company Group, we are not just adopting this transformation \- we are defining how it creates business value at scale. We are now looking for a Digital Lifecycle Strategist to strengthen Strategic Product Planning and play a key role in defining our future product portfolio direction.
   

  

 Why This Role is Different
   

  

 This is not a technology development role, and it is not a role focused on building digital services.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact strategic leadership role where you will define how software\-defined vehicle (SDV) capabilities translate into product portfolio direction, lifecycle value models, and long\-term business impact.
   

  

 You will ensure that SDV capabilities are reflected in the product plan, portfolio priorities, and lifecycle strategies, enabling sustainable value creation beyond the point of sale.
   

  

 What You Will Drive
   

  

**As Digital Lifecycle Strategist, You Will**
* Define the strategic framework connecting product strategy, feature roadmaps, lifecycle value models, and digital monetization
* Identify and prioritize strategic SDV initiatives impacting the product portfolio
* Shape how SDV capabilities influence product evolution and portfolio priorities (incl the ability to decouple functionality from hardware, enable continuous feature evolution, and create lifecycle\-based value streams through software, connectivity, and data)
* Establish principles for lifecycle value creation, including feature packaging and value capture over time
* Influence investment decisions and portfolio trade\-offs by integrating lifecycle thinking into the product plan


 Your future team
   

  

 You will join Strategic Product Planning, a highly strategic function within Trucks Technology. The team plays a central role in setting the direction of the long\-term product portfolio, translating business and customer needs into strategic product priorities, and navigating industry transformation.
   

  

 We work cross\-functionally and globally, with strong collaboration across brands and engineering.
   

  

 Who are you?
   

  

 You are not learning software\-defined vehicles \- you have already operated in this space for long and understand how software, connectivity, and business models reshape the product lifecycle.
   

  

* You bring 10\+ years of experience in strategic roles within automotive OEMs, technology companies, or adjacent industries
* You have direct experience shaping product strategy, lifecycle offerings, or digital monetization at scale
* You have influenced portfolio\-level decisions, not just contributed to individual initiatives
* You understand the intersection of product planning, software platforms, and business models in a software\-defined vehicle context


 You combine strategic thinking with strong business acumen and a holistic, future\-oriented mindset. You are comfortable operating in complex environments where industry standards are still evolving, and you can turn ambiguity into clear direction, focus areas, and priorities that guide long\-term decision\-making.
   

  

 You build trust through collaboration and are recognized for bringing stakeholders together across functions, brands, and levels. At the same time, you are confident challenging assumptions, highlighting difficult trade\-offs, and helping organizations converge on decisions that create long\-term impact.
   

  

 You take a data\-driven approach to strategy, simplifying complexity into actionable insights, and communicate with clarity and impact. Whether through storytelling, visualization, or executive dialogue, you are able to articulate direction in a way that drives alignment and momentum.

title: Associate Director - Growth & Retention
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero\-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad\-tech and bank\-tech software services.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As Senior Manager / Associate Director – Growth \& Retention, you will own the full lifecycle P\&L—from activation to repeat behaviour to reactivation—and lead a multidisciplinary team of 12–15 across analytics, CRM, campaign operations, personalisation, and rewards. This is a function\-head role. You will set strategy, manage a significant incentive budget, and represent Growth \& Retention in leadership forums.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 ● Full Lifecycle P\&L: CLTV, contribution margin, incentive budget allocation, and ROAS across all customer segments and product lines.
 



 ● Activation: Turn new users (especially checkout\-origin) into first\-time transactors on Snapmint; drive app adoption and reduce time\-to\-first\-purchase.
 



 ● Deepening Engagement: Build the repeat flywheel—cross\-sell across marketplace, vouchers, personal loans, and recharges; increase multi\-product adoption.
 



 ● Retention \& Reactivation: Prolong active lifespan, predict and reduce churn, run winback campaigns with documented payback periods.
 



 ● Rewards \& Loyalty: Oversee the rewards programme as an integrated lifecycle lever—merchant partnerships, unit economics, and programme ROI.
 



 ● Team \& Organisational Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing team; set quarterly priorities; be the executive stakeholder for the CRM/engagement tech stack
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 ● 7\+ years of experience, with 4\+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth at a consumer internet or fintech company.
 



 ● 3\+ years of people management—you’ve led and developed teams during high\-growth phases.
 



 ● Proven P\&L ownership—you’ve been accountable for a lifecycle or retention budget and its economic outcomes, not just engagement metrics.
 



 ● Strong analytical foundation: SQL, Python, CLTV/RFM modelling, A/B testing, and cohort economics.
 



 ● Hands\-on familiarity with CRM platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar) and multi\-channel campaign design (push, WhatsApp, SMS, email, IVR).
 



 ● Exposure to rewards or loyalty programme mechanics is a strong plus.
 



 ● A leader who sets the agenda, makes decisions with margin and payback in mind, and drives cross\-functional influence with Product, Credit, and Data Science.

title: Partner Technical Manager
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

 As the accountable owner for a portfolio of high\-impact GSI partnerships, you'll set direction, establish operating cadence, and align internal and partner stakeholders around measurable outcomes. * Drive joint go\-to\-market plans with Sales, Solutions, and Marketing, spanning field enablement, positioning, and demand generation

title: Debug Partnerships Manager
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, management consulting, or investment banking.
* Experience in the Consumer Electronics, Auto, OEMs, Telecom, E\-Commerce/Retail, Apps, Ads, Gaming, or Technology industries.
* Experience working with C\-level executives and cross\-functionally across all levels of management.
* Experience managing agreements or partnerships.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in Public Health or Life Sciences.
* 12 years of experience in business development, corporate development, strategic partnerships, or technology licensing in life sciences or public health in India.
* Experience structuring, negotiating, and closing commercial agreements.
* Experience building a new market, business unit, or product footprint from scratch in India.
* Experience in regulated environments, and in managing and structuring alliances in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or related industries.
* Ability to travel (up to 50% depending on location).


**About the job** 
 Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
   

  

 Debug ( debug.com ), a Google initiative to reduce mosquito\-borne diseases, has spent over a decade developing end\-to\-end technologies to help protect the 4 billion people worldwide at risk of dengue. By integrating custom software, hardware automation, scientific innovation, and AI, Debug delivers both mosquito suppression and replacement solutions at scale. At the core of this approach is Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that serves as a precise, chemical\-free way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases.
   

  

 As the Partnerships Manager for India, you will be the entrepreneurial driver establishing Debug’s footprint from the ground up. You will navigate complex regulatory pathways, architect technology licensing partnerships, and bridge global engineering with local operational deployment to reduce mosquito\-borne disease. The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive debug’s effort in India to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategy and partnerships that can establish debug as a trusted vector\-control solution.
* Lead the agreement sourcing and execution including origination, evaluation, developing market strategies, and negotiating complex technology licensing agreements and commercial agreements with local operational partners, private enterprises, and public health entities.
* Structure and negotiate operational models with partners by working with internal science and program manager teams to formulate field requirements with technical capabilities and program timelines.
* Evaluate opportunities, conduct due diligence, negotiating agreement terms, and working with cross\-functional teams to prepare and present recommendations to senior leadership. Ensure the consistent exercise of appropriate judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Identify, establish, and grow relationships with existing and new partners. Act as the central point of contact and maintain comprehensive account knowledge.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
