title: Marketplace Channel Lead
description:
About California Design Den
 



 California Design Den is a US premium home\-textiles brand — bedding and bath — sold across the major US online marketplaces and national retailers. We are founder\-led and profitable, with teams in the United States and India.
 



  





 About the role
 



 Amazon is the bulk of our business today. Our other marketplaces — Walmart, Target, Wayfair, Kohl's and Nordstrom — are the growth story, and right now they run as a part\-time extension of an Amazon\-shaped week. We're hiring the person who owns them. This is a commercial ownership role, not an account\-management or listing\-maintenance seat. You will own what we sell on every marketplace that isn't Amazon: the assortment, the pricing architecture, the promotional calendar, the retailer relationships, and the number.
 



  





 What you'll own
 



 • The growth number for Walmart, Target, Wayfair, Kohl's, Nordstrom and any channel we add.
 



 • The channel plan — which SKUs, at what price architecture, with what promotional calendar, and why. A channel is not a mirror of the Amazon catalogue.
 



 • Walmart first — concentrate our proven SKUs in WFS, run a coupon strategy aligned to the wider deal calendar, and bring Walmart advertising in\-house.
 



 • Channel advertising — own the budget and performance on Walmart Connect first, then the others as they scale.
 



 • Retailer relationships — own the merchant and category\-team relationship at each retailer: programme access, promotional slots, item\-setup escalations, compliance.
 



 • The pricing and margin case per channel — build it and bring it; retailer fee structures, fulfilment economics, competitive floor. (Final pricing sits with our pricing function; you own the argument.)
 



 • Channel health \& competitive intelligence — keep constant watch on content quality, organic visibility and search rank, ratings and reviews, assortment coverage and in\-stock availability, and competitors' pricing and promotions; surface the issues and the openings that move the growth number.
 



 • Channel demand \& availability — forecast demand by channel, flag fulfilment and stock constraints early, and make the case to supply chain to steer inventory toward the highest\-value marketplace opportunities. (Allocation sits with supply chain; you own the forecast and the argument.)
 



 • The business reviews — monthly and quarterly, written by you, leading with a recommendation.
 



 • Expansion calls — the written read on any new channel: size of prize, cost to serve, and a recommendation with the numbers behind it.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



 • 3–5 years growing a US marketplace or retail.com channel commercially — Walmart Marketplace / WFS strongly preferred, or Target Plus, Wayfair, or a retailer\-dot\-com account — with a P\&L or a growth number attached to your name.
 



 • A builder, not a plan\-manager. You've personally stood up assortment, in\-housed ads, and negotiated promotional slots for a channel — not relayed retailer requirements for one that already had a team.
 



 • Commercially numerate: retailer fee structures, WFS and fulfilment economics, contribution margin, promotional lift and payback. You can build the case and defend it.
 



 • You've run marketplace advertising at the level of budget, placement and return.
 



 • You've managed a retailer merchant relationship directly and can point to something it unlocked.
 



 • You read the channel like an operator — you watch content, search rank, reviews, stock and competitor moves, and act before they cost you the number.
 



 • You write a business review that leads with a recommendation.
 



 • Amazon literacy expected — these channels move with the Amazon deal calendar. Strong Amazon category\-management or marketplace backgrounds are very welcome; what matters is that you've built a non\-Amazon channel commercially.
 



 • Home, textiles or a comparable considered\-purchase consumer category is a plus.
 



  





 Why this role is worth your time
 



 • You own a set of channels outright and report to the head of the function — a founding channel role, not a seat in a channel team.
 



 • Real scale behind Amazon to fund the bet, and a short path from idea to live.
 



 • A company that will back a commercial owner with the tools and the mandate to grow.
 



  





 How to apply
 



 Apply here on LinkedIn with your CV and a short note (4–6 lines) on one marketplace channel you grew: where it started, what you changed, and where it ended — and the one thing you'd do first at Walmart.

* Stay current on the Life Sciences ecosystem of product partners and Cognizant proprietary industry solutions and accelerators, mapping client use cases to strengthen proposal differentiation.
* Curate reusable solution assets and reference architectures that accelerate proposal turnaround for Life Sciences opportunities.

**Work model**
 At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Kolkata. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, or business; MBA or relevant master's preferred.
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in business development, pre\-sales, or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on the Life Sciences industry.
* Understanding of commercial value chains, medical affairs, patient support programs, field\-force effectiveness, and omni\-channel engagement models.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Is a market professional. Market expertise includes understanding the reasons customers purchase products. This includes a deep understanding of the competition, and how customers think of and buy your product. Product Managers need market research and competitive analysis skills to complete these tasks
* Acts as the product’s leader within the company
* Develops the business case for new products, improvements to existing products, and business ventures
* Responsible for the development and positioning of 2\-3 mid\-size products or 1 large enterprise product that is global with responsibility for sophisticated customization. These products enable critical internal capabilities across the firm, supporting operational excellence and technology modernization objectives.
* Recommends or requires an awareness of competitive pricing to understand how pricing impacts product profit margin compared to competition
* Execute the product plan, collaborating with product owner, engineering and other teams
* Translate architectural direction into incremental deliverables. Lead technical discovery and spike activities to reduce delivery risk and accelerate time\-to\-value. Work closely with solution architects to ensure technical feasibility and alignment with enterprise standards.

* Develop metrics to assess the success of products and features and resolve vital enhancements
* Anticipate changes in market dynamics/models, adapts products, and creates product retirement and transitioning strategies
* Identify new products and features to create growth opportunities

* Collect business and technical input to define and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with architecture and platform capabilities. Partner with the BPM and engineering to continuously refine and sequence backlog items for efficient sprint execution

* Collaborate with user experience, business analysts and engineers with a focus on defining product functionality and designing solutions that bring differentiating value to our current and prospective clients
* Supervise market changes and trends to assess competitive positioning and opportunities for strategic product enhancements
* Provide regular updates about product direction and release plans to the senior partners and clients
* Monitor and report on delivery metrics such as lead time, user story cycle time, bug density, and mean time to restore service (MTTR) to ensure delivery health and continuous improvement.


**What We Look For**
 A technically fluent, outcome\-driven product leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to engage deeply in delivery detail. Someone who can coach teams, manage complex technical dependencies, and drive clarity between business intent and engineering execution
   

  

 A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition and passion!

description:
**Influencer Marketing Manager** 




 We're not hiring someone to spam micro\-influencers with free products. We need someone who builds real relationships with creators, sources authentic UGC, and turns creator content into a growth lever for HIRA and our portfolio brands.
 



 The role is
 **Influencer Marketing Manager.** 




 The reality is — you own community, creator partnerships, and UGC that actually converts.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Creator Sourcing \& Outreach** 



* Find micro\-influencers who actually fit the brand (not just follower count)
* Build relationships with creators — be someone they want to work with again
* Pitch partnerships that feel authentic, not transactional
* Negotiate rates and deliverables without overpaying



**UGC \& Content Strategy** 



* Brief creators on what to make and why (product features, brand story, lifestyle angle)
* Ensure content works both organically and as paid ads
* Source unboxing, testimonial, and lifestyle UGC
* Repurpose creator content into Meta/Google ads with performance tracking



**Campaign Management** 



* Run influencer campaigns end\-to\-end (briefing → content → posting → tracking)
* Manage timelines and deliverables
* Handle affiliate/promo code tracking
* Build repeat creator relationships — lock in people who work



**Performance \& Analytics** 



* Track creator content performance (engagement, reach, saves, conversions)
* Know which creators drive actual sales vs vanity metrics
* Build creator cohort analysis — what type of creator works best?
* Optimize spend based on creator ROI



**Community Building** 



* Engage with creator communities — be present, responsive
* Foster brand advocates who want to work with you repeatedly
* Handle DMs, comments, and community feedback
* Build a "creator network" that feels like a community, not a vendor list



  





**You might be the one if —** 



* You have 2–4 years influencer marketing experience in D2C, beauty, or lifestyle
* You've managed creator relationships and built repeat partnerships
* You understand Instagram algorithm — why some content pops, why some doesn't
* You know the difference between an influencer and an actual fit for your brand
* You've sourced and negotiated with micro\-influencers (the real ROI lies here)
* You've tracked UGC performance and optimized for actual conversions
* You're comfortable with social media — you spend time on Instagram, you know trends
* Prior experience in fragrance, beauty, or FMCG D2C is a plus
* You think like a curator, not a marketer — you're finding people, not broadcasting



  





  





**Why Meolaa:** 




 Meolaa is launching with influencers as a core channel. You'll own creator relationships, UGC strategy, and community building from day one. You're not supporting someone else's strategy — you're building it.
 



 You'll work with the Growth team to repurpose your UGC into paid ads. You'll have real budget. And you'll see direct impact when creator content drives conversions.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist, Asset Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Northern Trust Asset Management's global marketing strategy is evolving, our team is growing and we’re looking for individuals interested in growing with us. We are seeking passionate, results\-driven, creative thinkers, with a high attention to detail who value collaboration.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing Operations, the Marketing Operations Specialist position is a generalist role within our production team in Marketing Operations. The production team establishes and adapts the update cycle process and procedures to create scale and mitigate marketing/business risk. This includes, but is not limited to, creating a cycle framework, implementing regulatory updates, managing collateral updates, and automating deliverables. The team also assists with Seismic, specifically content maintenance and uploads and executing tasks designed to modernize the platform.
   

  

 The Marketing Operations Specialist has primary responsibility for the updating, maintenance and production of our quarterly and annual performance marketing content and materials across print and digital platforms. Secondarily, during off\-update cycle periods, the Specialist will take on additional efficiency projects.
   

  

 The role will require strong collaboration and partnership within Marketing and across Data Operations and Technology, Product Development and Management, Investments and Client Portfolio Management, Compliance and Legal, and Distribution to establish clear objectives and priorities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Complete quarterly/annual update cycle of collateral materials (pitchbooks, profiles, flyers, bios, etc.) including content updates, status reporting, compliance submissions, and being well\-versed with all data and sources (performance, characteristics, rankings, internal databases, etc.)
* Create and manage procedures to efficiently and effectively scale content update \& maintenance, mitigate risk and comply with industry and internal standards
* Establish and maintain relationships throughout the firm, across Compliance, Technology/Data, Client Portfolio Managers/Portfolio Managers, Distribution, Reporting, and others
* Implement ad hoc content updates due to organization changes, fund actions, and regulatory rules \& changes, as established by governing bodies (SEC, FINRA, ASIC, FCA, ESMA, etc.), across various investment offerings, regions, and marketing assets, including coordinating changes to product webpages
* Review and identify opportunities to use technology to support efficiency and/or automation of marketing content and recurring deliverables, eliminating data dependency, redundancy \& reduce cycle time
* Be intellectually curious, gain a knowledge and understanding of our products, as well as continuing to research and learn about Marketing Operations and production advances in the industry
* Increase productivity by simplifying workflows using data and AI‑and automation\-driven tools
* Support the overall Marketing Operations team, acting as back\-up support for other roles and responsibilities within the group as designated


**Experience \& Skills**
 The successful candidate will benefit from having:
   

  

* 3 years of financial services performance/data update experience preferred
* Understanding of the investment management industry, familiarity with investment vehicles, marketing constructs, regulatory requirements, and distribution channels preferred
* Effective collaboration and communication (verbal \& written) skills
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, with a commitment to quality
* Ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to follow established procedures and maintain accurate records
* Ability to think creatively and outside the box to find to solutions to known problems
* Demonstrated ability to multi\-task, ­effectively manage and navigate multiple projects, organize competing objectives and manage deadlines
* Strong work ethic and professional demeanor
* Creative and technical abilities across the Microsoft office suite, including Copilot


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**
 The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

 We’re looking for energetic, curious and creative \*\*Marketing Interns\*\* who want to get hands\-on experience building marketing for a real consumer brand.
 



 This is not a typical internship where you'll spend three months making presentations and watching from the sidelines.
 



 You’ll be involved in \*\*coming up with ideas, executing them, testing what works and measuring the results.\*\*
 



  





 \#\#\# What You'll Work On
 



  





 Depending on your strengths and interests, you could work on projects across:
 



 \*\*Social Media \& Content
 



 \* Plan and execute Instagram content and Reels
 



 \* Come up with creative content ideas around food, customers and the brand
 



 \* Help create photos and videos at our outlets
 



 \* Experiment with different content formats and understand what performs
 



 \* Build and maintain a content calendar
 



  





 \*\*Local Store Marketing
 



 \* Identify marketing opportunities around our outlets
 



 \* Plan campaigns targeting nearby colleges, offices, apartments and communities
 



 \* Explore partnerships with local businesses and communities
 



 \* Come up with ideas to increase awareness and footfall
 



  





 \*\*Customer Growth
 



 \* Develop ideas to bring in new customers
 



 \* Find ways to increase repeat orders
 



 \* Work on referral, loyalty and promotional campaigns
 



 \* Explore WhatsApp and other customer engagement channels
 



  





 \*\*Marketing Experiments
 



 \* Identify a problem or opportunity
 



 \* Come up with a campaign or experiment
 



 \* Execute it with the team
 



 \* Measure the results
 



 \* Figure out what worked and what didn't
 



  





 \*\*Competitor \& Market Research
 



 \* Study other food and QSR brands
 



 \* Track their campaigns, offers and content
 



 \* Identify interesting ideas that RKN can learn from or test
 



  





 \#\#\# What We're Looking For
 



  





 You don't need to have previous marketing experience.
 



 We care more about \*\*how you think and how much initiative you take.\*\*
 



  





 You'd be a great fit if you:
 



 \* Are creative and constantly coming up with ideas
 



 \* Understand Instagram, Reels and social media culture
 



 \* Enjoy creating content or experimenting with new formats
 



 \* Communicate well and aren't afraid to approach people
 



 \* Are curious about why customers behave the way they do
 



 \* Can take an idea from concept to execution
 



 \* Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving, hands\-on environment
 



 \* Are willing to go beyond your assigned task when you see something that can be improved
 



  





 \*\*Students pursuing Marketing, Business, Media, Design, Communications or similar fields are welcome to apply.\*\*
 



  





 But your degree matters less to us than your \*\*ability, curiosity and attitude.\*\*
 



  





 \#\#\# What You'll Get
 



  





 \* Hands\-on experience working with a real consumer/food brand
 



 \* Ownership of actual marketing projects
 



 \* Opportunity to see your ideas go from concept to execution
 



 \* Exposure to social media, local marketing, customer acquisition and brand building
 



 \* Regular feedback and mentorship
 



 \* A portfolio of real projects and campaigns you can showcase
 



 \* Certificate of internship on successful completion
 



 \* \*\*Performance\-based opportunity for continued work with Roti Kulcha Naan\*\*
 



  





 \#\#\# What Success Looks Like
 



  





 By the end of the internship, you shouldn't just be able to say:
 



  





 \> "I interned at bla bla bla."
 



  





 You should be able to say:
 



  





 \> "I ran these campaigns, created this content, tested these ideas and generated these results."
 



  





 That's what we're looking for.
 



  





 \#\#\# How to Apply
 



  





 Send us:
 



  





 \*\*1\. Your resume\*\*
 



 \*\*2\. A short introduction about yourself\*\*
 



 \*\*3\. One marketing idea you'd like our brand to try\*\*
 



  





 No fancy cover letter required.

* Own competitive intelligence across PostgreSQL\-compatible databases, distributed SQL entrants, cloud\-provider offerings, and legacy RDBMS vendors. Keep it rigorous, keep it current, and make it usable in a live deal.
* Run analyst relations alongside the VP: briefings, inquiries, and submissions to Gartner, Forrester, and GigaOm.
* Partner with developer relations so community messaging, open\-source storytelling, and go\-to\-market motion reinforce each other rather than diverge.
* Build sales enablement that shortens ramp time and lifts win rates. Be the person a seller calls the night before a competitive bake\-off.
* Drive partner and ecosystem marketing, with particular focus on the AI ecosystem: model providers, agent frameworks, and AI infrastructure partners.
* Report on pipeline influenced, win rate against named competitors, launch adoption, and content engagement, and use those numbers to decide what to stop doing.
* Feed market signal back into the roadmap. You'll have a standing seat with Product and leadership, and we expect you to use it.



  





**What You Bring\-** 




  





 We're hiring for a high bar, and these are the things we require from the candidates:
 


* 10\+ years in product marketing, with substantial time in databases, data infrastructure, or cloud\-native platforms. You know this terrain, and you don't need a ramp to understand why replication and consistency models matter.
* Technical credibility. You don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own with a staff engineer or a skeptical DBA and earn their respect in the first ten minutes.
* A portfolio of positioning and messaging work you can walk us through: what the market believed before, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.
* Experience supporting a developer\-led or open\-source motion. You understand that community trust is earned slowly and spent quickly.
* Demonstrated ownership of cross\-functional launches where you carried the outcome, not just the project plan.
* Exceptional writing. A post, a one\-pager, and an analyst brief should all read like they came from the same clear\-thinking company.
* Good presentation skills. Expect to present to a technical audience during virtual and in\-person events
* Startup or scale\-up experience. You operate with speed, ambiguity, and fewer resources than the plan assumed.
* Fluency with AI tooling in your actual workflow( research, drafting, competitive monitoring, synthesis). Be ready to show us how it changed your throughput, not just that you've tried it.
* Comfort operating from India on a global charter. Flexibility for local and international travel.



  





**Nice to have\-** 




  




* Meaningful depth in PostgreSQL, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience marketing an open\-source product alongside a commercial offering.
* Prior analyst relations ownership.
* Experience as the first senior marketing hire in a region.



  





**Why Yugabyte\-** 




  




* **A once\-in\-a\-career window.** 
 YugabyteDB is central to solving the world’s AI agent and application problems. Every week, new opportunities arise. It’s fun, it’s fast\-paced, and it’s something you’ll be proud of later in your career.
* **Category\-defining technology.** 
 YugabyteDB is the open\-source distributed SQL database built for cloud\-native applications. It's PostgreSQL\-compatible, globally distributed, and production\-proven at scale.
* **Real traction.** 
 Yugabyte is trusted by leading enterprises across financial services, retail, gaming, and beyond. This isn't a pre\-revenue bet.
* **A team that ships.** 
 Product and engineering move fast. You'll have no shortage of launches to lead or stories to tell.
* **Marketing leadership who's in the trenches with you.** 
 This role reports directly to the VP of Product Marketing and Developer Relations, someone who cares deeply about craft and will invest in your growth.
* **Competitive compensation.** 
 Salary, equity, and benefits commensurate with a senior role at a well\-funded, high\-growth company.

title: RM - Permission calling  (Marketing - B2B )
description:
**Company Description** 
 NoBrokerHood is a technologically advanced visitor, community, and finance \& asset management platform designed to make life secure and convenient for gated societies across India. Launched in 2018 as a subsidiary of NoBroker, India’s first prop\-tech unicorn, it has rapidly grown to manage over 25,000 societies and support the safety and convenience of more than 4\.8 million families. The platform serves all key stakeholders with dedicated interfaces for society administrators, management committees, security guards, and residents, and offers services ranging from home maintenance to renting or selling property. NoBrokerHood also enables revenue\-generation opportunities for societies and partner businesses through monetization and marketplace features. Backed by strong data security standards including Level 1 PCI\-DSS, GDPR, PDPB 2019, and ISO 27001 certifications, NoBrokerHood recently received $5 million funding from Google to further expand and enhance its offerings.
   

**Role Description** 
 The RM – Permission Calling (Marketing – B2B) role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Navi Mumbai. This role focuses on connecting with decision\-makers in residential societies and communities to obtain permission, schedule meetings, and introduce NoBrokerHood’s solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include making outbound B2B calls, explaining product features clearly, qualifying leads, and capturing accurate information in internal systems. The role also involves coordinating with the sales and marketing teams to support campaigns, follow up with prospects, and help drive adoption and revenue opportunities. The individual in this position is expected to maintain high standards of professionalism, adhere to compliance and data privacy guidelines, and meet defined calling and conversion targets.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to confidently engage with management committee members and other decision\-makers.
* Experience in outbound calling, telesales, or inside sales, preferably in B2B or real estate / housing society solutions.
* Ability to understand and explain technology products or apps, including basic comfort with CRM tools and call\-tracking systems.
* Solid organizational and time\-management skills to handle high call volumes, follow\-ups, and documentation accurately.
* Customer\-centric mindset, active listening skills, and the ability to handle objections and negotiate permissions effectively.
* Comfort working in an on\-site, target\-driven environment, with a focus on achieving daily and monthly KPIs.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in any discipline; relevant certification or training in sales, marketing, or customer service is an advantage.
* Prior experience in community management, property technology, or housing society services is beneficial but not mandatory.

title: Executive - SEO/ASO
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear – to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next. If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn't a typical
 **Executive \- SEO/ASO** 
 role.
   

  

 Crypto moves in hours, not quarters – and the people who win are the ones who can explain it clearly, fast, and at scale. As an SEO Executive, you'll be at the front line of how millions of Indians learn about crypto, blockchain, and Web3 through CoinDCX. You'll turn market moves, price action, and complex concepts into sharp, search\-optimised content that ranks, educates, and builds trust.
   

  

 This role exists because content is one of our most powerful engines for organic discovery and user education. You'll write daily, ship at pace, and learn how great content compounds into real traffic and real growth – while building deep expertise in one of the fastest\-evolving industries in the world.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Create and validate SEO\-optimised content – write blog content on the crypto industry covering trending updates, price predictions, and in\-depth educational articles.
* Deliver 3–4 articles daily , each 1,600–2,000\+ words, using a functional understanding of technical analysis of price charts to sharpen quality and relevance.
* Ideate and research – generate fresh content ideas and build unique content IPs, staying ahead of the latest in crypto, blockchain, and Web3, and tracking global market trends and price movements to shape content strategy.
* Execute core SEO tasks – build cohesive interlinking across articles, craft engaging meta titles and descriptions, and track performance in Google Search Console and Google Analytics to generate actionable reports and insights.
* Expand into new verticals – develop and manage content for new verticals across multiple products in the CoinDCX portfolio.
* Fuel community \& social content – create brief, price\-centric posts and content IPs for the community and social media platforms.
* Own publishing on CMS – upload, format, and SEO\-optimise blog content end\-to\-end in a Content Management System


**You'll Excel in This Role If You**
* Have 2–3 years of experience creating crypto\-related or fintech content.
* Write clearly and fast, and can handle a high\-volume content schedule without dropping quality.
* Have a foundational understanding of blockchain, crypto, and Web3 trends.
* Are familiar with global crypto market dynamics and trading tools, and can read price charts at a functional level.
* Know the SEO basics – interlinking, meta tags, GSC, and GA – and are hungry to go deeper.
* Are comfortable publishing and optimising content in Content Management System
* Are curious, self\-driven, and stay plugged into crypto news as it breaks.
* Know the basics of App Store Optimisation


**You'll Know You're Winning When**
* You’re consistently shipping 3–4 high\-quality, well\-optimised articles a day.
* Your articles are ranking and pulling in growing organic traffic month over month.
* Your content IPs are being read, shared, and reused across community and social channels.
* Interlinking, meta, and on\-page basics are clean and consistent across everything you publish.
* Your GSC and GA reports are turning into insights the team actually acts on.


**Why This Role Matters \& What's In It For You**
 This is a role where you learn fast and see your impact quickly. You'll build real SEO and content craft, develop deep crypto and Web3 knowledge, and watch your work turn into measurable organic growth. You'll work alongside a sharp growth team and grow into a specialist in one of the world's fastest\-moving industries.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here's what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent.
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better.
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving.
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take\-home task or live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios.
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best.
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long\-term fit.


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our Bangalore office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need.
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities.


**Ready to Build What's Next?**
 If you're looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

**Education**
 The Marketing Manager will plan, execute and manage AIMS's overall marketing, brand visibility, digital and performance marketing, content, social media, events and student acquisition activities. The role strengthens AIMS's position in the higher education market, drives visibility among prospective students and parents, and builds integrated campaigns that support institutional admission objectives, translating activity into measurable outcomes across:
   

  

***Brand Awareness → Engagement → Enquiries → Qualified Leads → Applications → Admissions***
 The role combines strategic thinking with hands\-on execution, managing internal teams, agencies and vendors across multiple campaigns simultaneously, and should be able to answer every month: Are more students aware of AIMS? Are the right students engaging? Are campaigns generating quality enquiries and sufficient applications? Is marketing investment producing measurable results?

* Marketing campaigns – digital, performance, social media and content
* Website, landing pages and SEO / organic visibility
* Lead\-generation campaigns and marketing events / activations

* Creative \& Leadership: content strategy, copywriting, storytelling, team and agency management, stakeholder management
* Attributes: strategic, creative, analytical, highly organised, commercially aware, target\-oriented, proactive and strong in execution – a doer, not only a planner


**REPORTING STRUCTURE \& ROLE BOUNDARY**
 Reports to the Head – Admissions \& Marketing, and supervises Digital Marketing, Social Media, Content, Creative, Events/Activation and Marketing Coordinator functions. Provides daily operational updates, a weekly performance report, a monthly marketing dashboard and a quarterly marketing review.

 The Marketing Manager is responsible for building AIMS's brand, creating market demand, generating high\-quality student enquiries and executing measurable marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels – combining brand management, performance marketing, content, social media, events, market intelligence, agency management and analytics to convert marketing investment into sustainable student enrolment growth, working closely with the Admissions Team.

description:
* **RetainIQ**

* **₹8\-10 LPA (based on experience)**



  






 If you've been doing marketing for a few years and find yourself more interested in the strategy and craft of customer retention than another Meta ads dashboard, read on.
   





**About us** 


 RetainIQ is a tech\-first retention marketing company based in Bangalore. We've built our own personalization platform that powers email and SMS programs for D2C brands across the US; candle companies, supplement brands, apparel labels, outdoor gear, pet products. Our SaaS tooling sits at the core of how we deliver retention outcomes that our clients can measure directly in revenue.
 





 We're hiring across the marketing team this year as we grow. This is one of the most important roles in the company; the person in this seat is the brain behind every brand's marketing program.
   





**What you'll actually do** 


 You'll own marketing strategy for 5\-6 D2C brand accounts. The work spans:
 



* Build the quarterly retention strategy for each brand you own. Where the revenue is coming from, where the gaps are, what to fix next.
* Translate strategy into monthly campaign calendars. Promotional sends, lifecycle flows, A/B tests, segmentation experiments.
* Write campaign briefs that designers and copywriters execute against. Some weeks you'll write copy yourself.
* Run weekly client calls. Read their data, present what's working and what's not, recommend the next move. These are senior\-level conversations with founders and marketing leads.
* Audit existing email and SMS programs. Find what's broken or missing and build a plan to fix it.
* Use our internal personalization platform, Klaviyo, Hiro Analytics, and a deep AI tooling stack to move 3\-5x faster than a traditional marketer.
* Work alongside a Designer, a Pod Lead, and a Customer Success Associate. Strong collaboration is the default mode.


**What we're looking for** 
* 1\-2 years in marketing of any flavor. Performance marketing, content marketing, brand marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, all relevant. Email marketing experience specifically is a plus but not a requirement.
* Comfortable with data. You should be able to look at a campaign report or a funnel chart, form a hypothesis about why the numbers look the way they do, and recommend a next step.
* Strong written communication. Briefs, copy, client emails, internal docs. Writing is most of the job. Strong writing is non\-negotiable.
* The ability to think in systems. Lifecycle marketing isn't a sequence of campaigns; it's an interconnected engine. We need someone who can see the engine.
* Comfortable on calls with US\-based clients. Confident, warm, articulate. You should be able to hold your own with founders and marketing leads.
* Klaviyo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, MoEngage, or any modern ESP experience is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you our stack.
* Service mindset paired with a strong point of view. You like clients and want them to win, but you also push back when they're wrong.


**What we're not looking for** 
* Pure media buyers who haven't done strategic or lifecycle work.
* Marketers who define themselves by which platform they ran ads on. We care how you think, not what platforms you've touched.
* People who think marketing is about creativity alone, with no patience for spreadsheets, performance data, or process. The role is 60% rigor, 40% craft.
* Candidates who view agency work as a stepping stone they want to leave in 12 months. The best growth here comes from staying long enough to own a real book of business.


**What you get** 
* ₹8\-10 LPA based on experience. The Specialist vs Strategist title is decided at offer based on level.
* Real ownership from week one. You'll be the named lead on 4\-5 brand accounts, not a junior on someone else's account.
* Exposure to 50\+ US D2C brands across categories. Few marketing roles in India offer this.
* AI\-augmented workflow. We invest heavily in tooling, including our own platform, and you'll come out of this knowing how to leverage AI for marketing better than 99% of marketers.
* Growth path: Senior Strategist, Pod Lead are the real next steps for the right person.
* Hybrid working out of our Bangalore office.



  





**How to Apply:** 




  





 Please fill this form \-\>
 **https://forms.gle/CS2AU27C6Wwmvy6K8** 




  





**Selection Process:** 



1. Apply via form
2. Assignment
3. L1 interview with a senior marketing strategist
4. L2 interview with marketing head

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**
* Driving strategic and tactical execution of device strategy from a Global/IO perspective, ensuring alignment with global, regional and affiliate launch priorities
* Leading device\-related lifecycle management activities by coordinating with regions, affiliates and cross\-functional stakeholders to support timely and effective execution
* Serving as the primary Global/IO point of contact for launch\-related queries, actions and issue resolution for in\-market and upcoming devices
* Independently driving commercial deliverables as part of the claims process, including identifying target claims, conducting cross\-functional processes and providing input across therapy areas
* Leading developmental projects including business case development and evaluations with multiple stakeholders
* Supporting governance, readiness tracking and stakeholder alignment for device launches by identifying risks, enabling decision\-making and driving completion of key launch deliverables
* Contributing to the development of new promotional and training materials as needed
* International travel of 5–10 days per year is expected.


**Your new department**
 In Product \& Portfolio Strategy we drive commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across all therapy areas. We act as a connector and compass, guiding the new Novo Nordisk portfolio for sustained competitiveness upstream, and maximising portfolio potential through successful commercial strategies and competitive launches downstream.
   

  

 You will be based in our P\&PS GBS office in Bangalore, working across Device Strategy \& Marketing (Global) and Portfolio \& Launch Strategy (IO). This is a highly cross\-functional role where you will engage with senior stakeholders across headquarters and international operations – from Vice Presidents and Senior Directors to Global Product Managers and R\&D teams – to ensure our device portfolio reaches patients effectively in markets around the world.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Qualifications**
 We are looking for someone who thrives in a complex, fast\-moving environment and can independently set direction while bringing others along. You will bring:
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical marketing, medical affairs, sales, brand management or project management – experience within the diabetes therapy area is preferred
* Proven ability to develop and implement tactical plans, with strong strategic and analytical capabilities demonstrated through working with complex data sets and translating insights into actionable strategies
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence at senior levels across a matrixed organisation
* Strong content writing skills and the ability to translate complex topics into clear, compelling communications and governance storylines
* A graduate degree in Pharma, Science, Biotechnology or Engineering, combined with a Master's degree (preferably in Marketing) from a well\-recognised institute
* Proficiency in MS PowerPoint, MS Excel and MS Word


**Working at Novo Nordisk**
 Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long\-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.
   

  

**Deadline**
 25 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
   

  

 At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Pune — on\-site
 



 This regional real\-estate developer has always sold through brokers and word of mouth in its home city. Its next project is in a second city where it has no existing broker network and no name recognition, which means digital is now the primary way it will reach buyers rather than a supporting channel. The company has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Digital Marketing Manager to own that shift.
 



**What you'd be building** 




 You will set up and run digital demand generation for a project launch from close to zero: paid search and social aimed at homebuyers researching a new city, a landing page and lead\-capture flow, and a retargeting sequence for people who visit a show apartment but do not book on the spot. Real estate lead cycles are long and this is not a lead\-farming role — you will be measured on qualified site visits and bookings, not raw form fills.
 



**How the launch team runs** 



* You report to the head of sales and marketing and work alongside the on\-ground sales team that handles site visits
* You manage the budget and agency relationship for paid media directly
* You track cost per qualified lead and cost per booking, and adjust spend weekly based on what sales is closing



**Who this role needs** 




 Two to seven years in digital or performance marketing, ideally with some real\-estate, high\-ticket, or long\-cycle\-purchase experience. You should be comfortable owning a paid budget directly, reading a CRM to understand what is actually converting to bookings rather than just leads, and working closely with an on\-ground sales team rather than at arm's length from them.
 


* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads, including landing\-page and retargeting setup
* Comfort with a CRM and basic funnel reporting



**What you'd get out of it** 




 You would be the first owner of a real digital budget at this company, not inheriting someone else's dashboards, with direct visibility into what converts to actual bookings and a straight line to the head of sales and marketing.
 



**How this moves** 




 A short case exercise on the launch, one round with the head of sales and marketing, and a decision within two weeks.
 



 This application also puts you forward for other digital marketing roles we are currently hiring for.

title: Brand Manager — Brand Research & Insights
description:
**About Snapmint:** 




 Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI e\-commerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.
 



  





 Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M\+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000\+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India \- and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry\-free.
 



  





 Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in.
 



 Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 We’re looking for a Brand Manager – Research \& Insights to build and own Snapmint’s brand intelligence function. You’ll bring together consumer research, brand tracking, competitive intelligence and data to help Snapmint better understand its consumers and make sharper brand and business decisions.
 



  





**Role Title:** 
 Brand Manager — Brand Research \& Insights
 



**Department:** 
 Marketing
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Fulltime
 



**Experience:** 
 3 \-5 Yrs.
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Working Model:** 
 Work from Office – 5 Days per Week
 



**Entity:** 
 Snapmint Credit Advisory Private Limited
 



  





**What You Own:** 



* Build a deep understanding of Snapmint’s consumers — personas, needs, behaviours, motivations and attitudes.
* Own quarterly brand tracking and brand health across awareness, consideration, preference, recall, trust and key brand metrics.
* Lead qualitative and quantitative consumer research across brand, product, communication and CX.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Track competitors, category trends and emerging consumer opportunities.
* Turn research and data into sharp, actionable insights for Brand, Product, Marketing and Business teams.
* Manage research agencies, partners and vendors end\-to\-end.
* Build a central consumer \& brand knowledge base for Snapmint.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* 3–5\+ years in Brand Strategy, Consumer Insights, Market Research or Brand Research.
* Strong understanding of qualitative \& quantitative research and brand measurement.
* Highly analytical and data\-driven, with the ability to turn data into clear business actions.
* Strong strategic thinking and storytelling skills.
* Experience in a high\-growth, B2C technology or consumer business.
* Naturally curious, with a strong ability to uncover the “why” behind consumer behaviour.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Graduate from a Tier\-1 institution.
* MBA in Marketing, Strategy or a related field.
* Experience building brand tracking/health frameworks from scratch.
* Experience in fintech, payments, e\-commerce or consumer internet.
* Experience managing research agencies and external research partners.



  





**Why Snapmint:** 



* Be Part of a 10X–100X Journey \- Help build and scale and be part of a high\-growth story.
* Raise the Bar \- Learn from people who raise the bar.
* Solve Hard Problems \- Work on meaningful, high\-impact challenges.
* Own the Outcome \- Take ownership and make things happen.
* Move Fast, Build Fast \- Turn ideas into action, not backlogs.
* Make Real Impact \- See your work reach millions of customers.
* Grow with Snapmint \- Take on bigger challenges as we scale.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**BrandCrest Holdings** 
 is a diversified business group committed to building agile, high\-impact brands across India’s evolving business landscape. We operate through three key verticals:
 


* **AdCrest –** 
 Our ATL\-led integrated marketing agency, planning and owning large\-scale outdoor, transit, cinema, radio, and digital OOH campaigns, integrating BajuGali for BTL execution and TrendLabs for digital marketing.
* **FinCrest –** 
 Our niche CFO services firm for startups and SMEs, offering virtual CFO leadership, financial reporting, compliance, taxation, and business process automation.
* **DigitalSME –** 
 Our AI\-powered SaaS suite, building business automation and workflow software, including invoicing and payroll/HR tools, with more products on the way.



  





**About the Role:** 




 We're hiring a Growth Manager to own and scale user acquisition, activation, and revenue growth across DigitalSME's product portfolio. DigitalSME is BrandCrest's newest vertical, currently commercializing its invoicing and payroll/HR software, so this is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role for someone who has done this before in an early\-stage B2B SaaS environment — someone who can build a growth engine from the ground up, not just run campaigns inside an existing one. You will report directly to the founding team.
 



 You'll work closely with the founding team, product, and sales to turn DigitalSME's product suite into a predictable pipeline of qualified SME/professional\-services customers, across both live products and upcoming launches. In the first few months, the priority is building repeatable acquisition and activation for the live products, before scaling across the full portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the growth strategy and roadmap across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion for DigitalSME's SaaS products.
* Build and manage multi\-channel demand generation — SEO, paid (search/social), content, email/lifecycle, partnerships, and outbound — with a clear eye on CAC and payback period.
* Define and instrument the growth funnel (awareness → demo → trial/signup → activation → paid → expansion), and own the metrics that matter: MQL/SQL conversion, CAC, LTV, activation rate, churn.
* Run structured, high\-velocity experimentation (A/B tests, landing pages, messaging, pricing/packaging) to find and scale what works.
* Partner with Product to improve onboarding and activation flows, using product\-led growth tactics where relevant.
* Work with Sales to ensure smooth handoff of qualified leads and tighten the marketing\-to\-sales loop.
* Build positioning and messaging for DigitalSME's live product lines (Invoice, Payroll \& HR), tailored to their specific buyer personas, and extend this to new lines (Advertising ERP, CA/Accounting ERP, Fraud Detection) as they launch.
* Set up and own growth reporting/dashboards; report results and learnings to leadership regularly.
* Manage growth budget and any external agencies/freelancers/tools.



  





**Specification:** 



* 2–3 years in a growth, performance marketing, or demand generation role, with a significant portion spent at a B2B SaaS company (early\-to\-growth stage strongly preferred).
* Proven track record of owning a growth funnel end\-to\-end and moving core metrics — CAC, activation, conversion, retention — with numbers to show for it.
* Strong hands\-on experience with paid acquisition, SEO, lifecycle/email marketing, and marketing/growth analytics tools (e.g., GA4, HubSpot/Zoho, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Meta/Google Ads).
* Comfortable with both strategy and execution — you're equally happy building a quarterly growth plan and personally shipping a landing page or campaign.
* Data\-driven and experiment\-led: you form hypotheses, test fast, and kill what doesn't work.
* Understanding of SME and professional\-services buyer behavior is a strong plus (agencies, accounting firms, consultancies).
* Excellent written communication — you'll be shaping positioning and messaging directly.
* Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and building processes rather than inheriting them.



  





**Qualification:** 



* Experience growing a product from early stage to a defined GTM motion.
* Exposure to product\-led growth (PLG) models alongside sales\-assisted motions.
* Familiarity with vertical SaaS or workflow/operations software for SMEs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines.



  





**Perks \& Benefits:** 



* Glass Door Work Culture
* Mentorship
* Flexible Hours
* Casual Wear
* Refreshment
* Parking
* Compensatory Offs
* Travel \& Expense Reimbursement
* Accidental Insurance
* Health Insurance
* Company Retreats
* Team Building Events
* ESOPs
* Networking \& Conference
* Job Training

title: Brand Manager (Marketing)
description:
**About KisanKraft** 





 KisanKraft Limited is a leading Bengaluru\-headquartered agricultural equipment and power tools company, dedicated to empowering farmers across India with modern, affordable farm mechanization solutions. With a 46\-acre manufacturing facility in Nellore, 14 branch offices, a dealer network of 5,000\+ partners across the country, and exports to 19\+ countries, KisanKraft is committed to driving productivity and innovation in the agricultural sector.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 We're looking for an energetic, versatile, and strategic Brand Manager to drive the company's brand presence across ATL, BTL, Digital Marketing, and PR. The role calls for a strong blend of creative thinking, strategic planning, and hands\-on execution to build brand visibility, positioning, and engagement across farmer, dealer, and institutional audiences.
 




  






 The ideal candidate has a genuine interest in the agricultural sector and rural economy and is willing to travel to calibrate branding efforts on the ground. You should be a self\-motivated leader, comfortable managing your own team, collaborating across divisions, and working with external agencies on PR and branding.
 




  






 You will lead all digital marketing activities for the brand — SEO, performance marketing, social media, influencer and affiliate marketing, and content creation — with an in\-house team of graphic designers and videographers, external support for performance marketing, and backing from our sales, service, CRM, and management teams.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Brand Strategy \& Creative Direction** 



* Own creative and strategic decisions that align with company goals, objectives, and budget.
* Lead idea development to create compelling, motivating campaigns that drive audience response.
* Develop branding collateral for digital platforms (graphics, videos, articles) and traditional formats (catalogues, brochures, diaries, calendars, wall paintings, signboards, flex banners, posters).
* Conceptualize campaigns for in\-store and exclusive\-store branding, including product branding, logo placement, colour schemes, packaging, and user manuals.
* Ensure consistent branding across online and offline channels.



  





**2\. Digital Marketing, E\-commerce \& Performance** 



* **Performance Marketing \& SEO:** 

 Execute and scale paid ad campaigns across Google and Meta; use keyword research and Google Search Console to monitor and improve search visibility.
* **E\-commerce \& Web Optimization:** 

 Manage website aesthetics and user experience — page layouts, imagery, and copywriting — to improve conversion rates.
* **Social Media \& Brand Growth:** 

 Plan and execute a consistent social media calendar to expand community reach and organic engagement.



  





**3\. Offline Retail \& BTL Execution** 



* Manage setup operations for new retail outlet openings.
* Participate in branding activities such as online campaigns, mobile showroom (display truck) tours, field demonstrations, exhibitions, TV/radio ads, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end design and nationwide fulfilment of physical print materials for regional teams.
* Support company events — season kick\-offs, annual dealer meetings, technician and farmer meetings, press meetings, etc.
* Visit dealers regularly to strengthen in\-store and neighbourhood branding.



  





**4\. Team Leadership** 



* Manage the in\-house creative pod — two graphic designers and one video editor — directing day\-to\-day operations and workflows.
* Work with external agencies on ATL, BTL, digital, and PR activities to strengthen KisanKraft's image among farmers, dealers, and government stakeholders.
* Build the team: recruit, train, and continuously raise the bar.



  





**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Market Intelligence** 



* Align the organization around a consistent marketing direction and product line strategy.
* Analyze brand positioning through market research, dealer and exhibition visits, consumer insights, and competitor tracking to identify opportunities and issues.
* Partner closely with the sales team to map branding activities to crops and seasons, ensuring strategy stays in sync with crop data across regions.



  





**6\. Performance Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Track and report on the performance of all marketing campaigns and branding activities, including progress of your team and external agencies, to management.
* Stay flexible to take on new assignments as business priorities shift.



  





**Travel** 





 Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, customers, and farmer events.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
 


  


 Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI\-powered automation software within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state\-of\-the\-art Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.
 


  


 Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales\-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.
 


  


**What you'll own:** 



  


**Pipeline generation** 



  

  
* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
  
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
  
* Build and run account\-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
  
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent\-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land
  


  


**Funnel ownership and conversion** 



  

  
* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed\-won, and diagnose where it leaks
  
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
  
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
  
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it
  


  


**Marketing operations and measurement** 



  

  
* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
  
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
  
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI
  


  


**Website ownership** 



  

  
* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
  
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
  
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
  
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
  
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
  
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
  
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
  
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market\-level site structure
  
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required
  


  


**Programmes and partners** 



  

  
* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
  
* Build co\-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
  
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
  
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* 5\+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
  
* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self\-serve motions
  
* Hands\-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
  
* Hands\-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
  
* Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
  
* Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
  
* Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
  
* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
  
* Strong written English
  
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day
  


  


**Strongly preferred** 



  

  
* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
  
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
  
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
  
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
  
* Experience in a company scaling from founder\-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine
  


  


**How we’ll know you are the right fit** 



  

  
* You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
  
* You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
  
* You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew
  


  


**First 90 days** 



  

  
* **Days 1 to 30:** 
 Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
  
* **Days 31 to 60:** 
 Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest\-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
  
* **Days 61 to 90:** 
 Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* **Shape a function from the ground up** 
 – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go\-to\-market.
  
* **Work with cutting\-edge AI** 
 – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise\-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
  
* **Global exposure** 
 – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
  
* **High ownership, low bureaucracy** 
 – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
  
* **Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives** 
 – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.
  


  


 This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Content Marketing Manager

 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.

 At BiteSpeed, marketing isn't about being the loudest voice in the room. It's about saying something worth listening to. We've built a product customers genuinely love, and now we're looking for someone who can tell that story in a way that educates, earns trust and makes people want to be a part of what we're building.
   

  

 As our
 **Content Marketer** 
 , you'll own our content engine end to end. From founder\-led thought leadership and product storytelling to SEO, customer stories and campaign content, you'll shape how thousands of marketers discover, learn about and remember BiteSpeed. If you're the kind of person who obsesses over a headline as much as a growth chart, you'll fit right in.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own BiteSpeed's content strategy across channels, ensuring everything we publish contributes to awareness, pipeline or customer education.
* Write and edit high\-quality content including blogs, case studies, product launches, newsletters, website copy, sales enablement content and thought leadership pieces.
* Partner closely with founders and subject matter experts to turn their ideas into content people actually want to read and share.
* Build and execute an SEO roadmap to drive sustainable organic growth while maintaining a high bar for quality.
* Develop customer stories, playbooks and educational content that showcase the value our customers create using BiteSpeed.
* Measure content performance, identify what resonates and continuously refine the strategy based on data and customer feedback.

 what excites you, and we’ll back you with trust and responsibility.

title: Chief of Staff, Marketing & Growth
description:
**About This Role**
 We're looking for a Chief of Staff to the Marketing \& Growth function who can bring structure, pace, and clarity to how the team operates and executes. This role sits at the center of the function — connecting strategy to execution, keeping cross\-functional workstreams on track, and ensuring leadership has the visibility and context needed to make good decisions fast.
   

  

 You'll work closely with marketing, sales, and revenue stakeholders to drive alignment across priorities, remove execution friction, and help the function scale with discipline.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Strategic Operations \& Execution**
* Translate leadership priorities into structured execution plans with clear owners, timelines, and milestones
* Track progress across key marketing and growth initiatives and surface blockers early
* Prepare leadership for key reviews, business meetings, and cross\-functional planning cycles


**Cross\-Functional Alignment**
* Act as a coordination layer between marketing, sales, revenue, and product teams
* Facilitate alignment on shared goals, pipeline targets, and GTM priorities across functions
* Represent the marketing and growth leadership in operational forums when needed


**Planning \& Rhythm of Business**
* Own the operating cadence for the function — quarterly planning, team reviews, and business reporting cycles
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting structures that give leadership clear visibility into function health and performance
* Drive the annual and quarterly planning process in close partnership with marketing leads


**Special Projects \& Leadership Support**
* Own discrete high\-priority projects that fall outside standard team structures
* Identify process gaps and build frameworks that improve how the team works and scales
* Support leadership on org\-level decisions, communication, and change management


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4–8 years of experience in marketing operations, strategy, consulting, or a Chief of Staff function
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing and growth motions — demand generation, GTM planning, pipeline contribution
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross\-functional workstreams with multiple stakeholders
* Comfortable working with funnel data, marketing analytics, and performance reporting
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to synthesize complexity and communicate clearly upward and across teams
* Proven ability to operate with minimal direction and hold multiple priorities simultaneously


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in a SaaS or technology\-led B2B environment
* Exposure to international GTM planning across APAC, EMEA, or Americas
* Prior experience in a marketing\-adjacent Chief of Staff or strategy role


 What Makes You a Strong Fit
   

  

* You're a strong systems thinker who can see both the detail and the bigger picture without losing either
* You operate with calm and structure in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments
* You earn trust quickly with peers and leadership by following through consistently
* You communicate with precision — in writing, in meetings, and in how you frame trade\-offs
* You treat execution as a discipline and bring the same rigor to operations that a marketer brings to campaigns


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 Marketing and growth functions move fast and span many workstreams — demand generation, GTM expansion, analytics, operations, and more. Without strong operational leadership at the center, execution becomes fragmented and leadership context gets lost. This role directly improves the function's ability to prioritize well, move fast, and scale with clarity.
   

  

 Why Join Us
   

  

* Work at the center of a marketing and growth function with real international scope and business impact
* Collaborate directly with senior leadership across marketing, sales, and revenue
* Operate with meaningful ownership over how the function runs and scales
* Join a team that values data, pace, and clear thinking over hierarchy and process
* Grow in a role with high visibility and direct influence on how the business evolves
