title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Partnership Management** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
 



  





**You Might Be Right For This If...** 



* You have 2\+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client\-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising
* You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number.
* You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed
* You can context\-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum
* Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to.
* You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you



  





**What You'll Get** 



* **Real ownership:** 
 Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one
* **Leadership exposure:** 
 Work directly with CXOs and cross\-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success
* **Growth trajectory:** 
 Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem
* **Compensation:** 
 Among the most competitive in India, including stock options
* **Global scope:** 
 Partners and markets that span continents — not a single\-geography desk job



  





**If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.** 




 Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

**About Us**
 At Assembly, we help brands find the change to fuel business growth. We are an award\-winning global brand performance agency, home to 1,600 talented people across 25 offices globally. We create unique data, technology and media solutions that enable faster and smarter problem solving and an inspired, collaborative workplace culture.
   

  

 At Assembly we embody three core values: Show Up \- actively contribute to a space of personal and collective growth; Make Change \- embrace obstacles as opportunities, taking intentional steps to drive positive change; and Win Well \- approach success with integrity, responsibility, and a commitment to collaboration, understanding that the journey is as important as the destination. Together, we create an environment that fosters continuous learning, adaptability, and a shared passion for making a meaningful impact.
   

  

 We stay ahead of what’s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas. We’re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges—in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming. Together, we create with confidence
   

  

**Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced Go\-to\-Market (GTM) Manager to lead commercialization initiatives for our Identity Graph platform and data products. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and Strategic Partnerships to successfully launch new data capabilities, onboard data vendors, negotiate commercial agreements, and drive successful product adoption.
   

  

 As this role involves daily collaboration with US\-based customers, data partners, legal teams, vendors, and cross\-functional stakeholders, the candidate must be comfortable working primarily during US business hours to ensure effective communication and timely decision\-making.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has prior experience in the AdTech, MarTech, Data, or Identity ecosystem and understands how audience data, identity resolution, measurement, enrichment, and privacy\-first solutions are commercialized and delivered to customers.
   

  

**( This role offers work from home, work timings: 5:30pm to 2:30am IST)**
**Responsibilities**
**Go\-to\-Market Strategy**
* Define and execute GTM strategies for new ID Graph capabilities, datasets, APIs, and platform features.
* Build launch plans for new data partnerships and product releases.
* Develop positioning, messaging, pricing recommendations, and commercial packaging.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to create customer\-facing collateral.


**Vendor \& Partner Management**
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic data vendors and technology partners.
* Lead commercial conversations with data providers, identity partners, measurement vendors, and technology platforms.
* Own vendor relationships from discovery through contract execution, launch, and renewal.
* Drive quarterly business reviews and monitor vendor performance against commercial and operational KPIs.


**Commercial Contract Management**
* Lead commercial negotiations with external vendors and strategic partners.
* Review and negotiate:
* Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Data Licensing Agreements
* Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
* Pricing schedules
* Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Commercial and payment terms
* Partner closely with Legal, Finance, and Procurement teams to finalize agreements.
* Track contract renewals, vendor obligations, and licensing compliance.


**Cross\-functional Leadership**
**Act As The Primary Liaison Between**
* Product Management
* Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Data Science
* Legal
* Finance
* Procurement
* Sales
* Customer Success
* External Vendors and Data Partners


 Drive alignment across teams to ensure successful partner onboarding and product launches.
   

  

**Product Discovery \& Partner Enablement**
* Participate in technical discovery sessions with Product and Engineering teams.
* Gather business and technical requirements from prospective partners.
* Evaluate partner capabilities and technical feasibility.
* Translate commercial requirements into product requirements.
* Support roadmap prioritization for external integrations and strategic partnerships.


**AdTech \& Identity Domain Expertise**
**Serve As The Business Expert Across**
* Identity Graphs
* Audience Data
* Audience Measurement
* Audience Activation
* Data Licensing
* Data Enrichment
* Data Clean Rooms
* Identity Resolution
* Customer Data Platforms (CDPs)
* Programmatic Advertising
* Privacy\-first Marketing


 Understand the commercial implications of data acquisition, licensing restrictions, privacy regulations, and partnership models.
   

  

**Financial \& Commercial Analysis**
* Develop business cases for new partnerships.
* Perform ROI and cost\-benefit analyses.
* Support pricing and packaging decisions.
* Work with Finance on vendor budgets and forecasting.
* Track commercial performance of new products and partnerships.


**Program Management**
* Manage GTM timelines across multiple workstreams.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Drive launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Operations.
* Ensure on\-time execution of partner onboarding and product launches.

* Strong understanding of:
* Identity Graphs
* Audience Measurement
* Audience Segmentation
* Data Enrichment
* Data Licensing
* DSPs, SSPs, CDPs
* Clean Rooms
* Programmatic Advertising
* Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial agreements with external vendors and partners.
* Strong understanding of contract terminology, licensing models, commercial negotiations, and vendor management.
* Experience working closely with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Must be willing and able to work during US business hours (EST/PST overlap) to support global stakeholders and partner engagements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with identity providers or data companies such as LiveRamp, Experian, TransUnion, Acxiom, Neustar, or similar organizations.
* Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and other data privacy regulations.

 **creative, enthusiastic, and business\-oriented Marketing \& Sales Intern** 
 with a basic understanding of finance or accounting. The ideal candidate will support Qoncil's marketing and sales initiatives, generate and qualify leads, engage with prospective customers, and contribute directly to converting opportunities into customers.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who wants to gain
 **hands\-on experience in B2B SaaS sales, fintech marketing, client acquisition, and enterprise business development** 
 , while applying their finance knowledge in a real\-world business environment.
   




 About Qoncil
 
  





**Qoncil is an AI\-driven automation company focused on building intelligent applications that simplify complex business processes.** 




 We combine
 **Artificial Intelligence, automation, and domain expertise** 
 to develop practical technology solutions for businesses, finance teams, enterprises, and professional organizations.
 



 Our applications are designed to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, accelerate decision\-making, and provide greater visibility and control over business processes.
 



 One of our key products,
 **Qoncil** 
 , is an intelligent reconciliation and automation platform designed to handle large volumes of financial and operational data with speed, accuracy, and control. The platform automates complex reconciliation processes across banks, intercompany transactions, vendors, customers, GST, and other operational datasets.
 



 Beyond reconciliation, Qoncil is building a broader ecosystem of
 **AI\-powered business applications and automation solutions** 
 , with a focus on solving real\-world business problems through intelligent technology.
 



 As an intern, you will get exposure not only to
 **marketing and sales** 
 , but also to how an emerging AI and automation company identifies business problems, develops technology solutions, takes products to market, and converts opportunities into customers.
   




 Role \& Responsibilities
 
 The Sales \& Marketing Intern will work closely with the sales and marketing teams and will be involved in the
 **complete lead\-to\-customer journey** 
 .
   




 Lead Generation \& Business Development
 * Research and identify potential clients across businesses, enterprises, finance teams, accounting firms, audit firms, and other relevant organizations.
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, email, networking, online research, referrals, and other business development channels.
* Build and maintain a database of prospective customers and decision\-makers.
* Identify relevant finance, accounts, audit, and business stakeholders within target organizations.
* Initiate conversations with potential customers and understand their business and automation requirements.
* Follow up with leads and maintain a structured lead pipeline.


 Client Visits \& Meetings

 for lead generation, meetings, product discussions, demonstrations, and relationship building.

* Interact with finance managers, CFOs, accountants, auditors, business owners, and other decision\-makers.
* Represent Qoncil professionally during client interactions and business meetings.
* Gather customer feedback and identify potential business opportunities.


 Sales \& Conversion
 * Qualify leads based on customer requirements, business potential, and product fit.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers and move leads through the sales pipeline.
* Understand customer pain points and communicate how Qoncil's products and automation solutions can address them.
* Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, quotations, and other sales documentation.
* **Work towards converting qualified leads into product demonstrations, trials, and ultimately paying customers.**
* Track sales opportunities and provide regular updates on lead status and conversions.
* Support the sales team in achieving lead\-generation and revenue targets.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing customers.


 Marketing \& Content
 * Assist in creating marketing content for LinkedIn, presentations, brochures, email campaigns, and other channels.
* Support digital marketing and content marketing initiatives.
* Help create finance\- and business\-focused content relevant to CFOs, finance teams, accountants, auditors, enterprises, and business owners.
* Assist with LinkedIn marketing, campaign activities, and customer engagement.
* Track basic campaign performance and prepare reports.
* Use Canva, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to develop marketing content and sales collateral.
* Support the development of case studies, product presentations, promotional material, and other marketing assets.


 Product \& Process Learning
 * Learn Qoncil's products, features, use cases, and value proposition.
* Understand how AI and automation can be applied to solve real\-world business problems.
* Participate in internal training sessions and product demonstrations.
* Understand common reconciliation, finance, accounting, and operational challenges faced by businesses.

 **AI, automation, B2B marketing, sales, SaaS, and fintech** 
 .


 Preferred Skills

 What You'll Gain

 .

 .

 If you are interested in

Embassy Group, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Bangalore, is one of Indias leading real estate developers with a diversified portfolio spanning commercial office spaces, luxury residential projects, hospitality,retail, and education. It is known for landmark developments such as Manyata Business Park and Embassy GolfLinks, and for pioneering Indias first listed REIT Embassy Office Parks REIT With a strong focus on sustainability, renewable energy, and community development, Embassy Group continues to shape Indias urban landscape while maintaining global standards in design and execution
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




  





 To drive product marketing strategies for luxury residential developments by understanding customer preferences, market trends, and competitive offerings. The role is responsible for developing compelling product concepts, creating go\-to\-market strategies, managing integrated marketing campaigns, supporting project launches, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to maximize brand visibility and sales performance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Product Strategy \& Market Research** 



* Conduct market research to understand customer profiles, buying behaviour, lifestyle preferences and evolving expectations within the luxury residential segment.
* Analyse competitor projects, market trends, neighbourhood developments, infrastructure, pricing and customer offerings to identify market opportunities.
* Partner with Design and Projects teams to evaluate market feasibility and develop differentiated product concepts.
* Develop concept presentations, positioning documents and business cases to support product development and decision\-making.
* Work with Design Consultants and internal stakeholders on product concept finalization, detailing and budget considerations.
* Identify emerging customer and market trends and translate insights into actionable product and marketing strategies.



  





**Marketing Strategy \& Campaign Management** 



* Develop annual marketing strategies, campaign calendars and budgets aligned with business, brand and sales objectives.
* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, outdoor, direct marketing, channel partners and events.
* Develop clear product positioning, messaging and value propositions aligned with the target customer segment.
* Drive campaigns that generate qualified leads and contribute towards sales conversion.
* Track campaign performance, KPIs and ROI and continuously optimize marketing initiatives.
* Ensure all marketing communication is aligned with brand guidelines and applicable RERA and regulatory requirements.
* Develop innovative marketing initiatives to enhance project visibility, customer engagement and market differentiation.



  





**Product Launch \& Go\-to\-Market Execution** 



* Develop and execute end\-to\-end Go\-to\-Market (GTM) strategies for new residential projects and product launches.
* Coordinate with Projects, Design and Sales teams for the development of marketing offices, experience centres, mock\-up apartments, project models, walkthroughs, renders, brochures and other marketing collaterals.
* Plan and execute project launches, pre\-launches, sales events, promotions and customer engagement initiatives.
* Develop launch communication and marketing plans aligned with project milestones and sales requirements.
* Support product training and communication for Sales teams and channel partners to ensure effective articulation of the product proposition.
* Ensure consistency of product positioning and customer experience across all project touchpoints.



  





**Agency \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Manage relationships with advertising, creative, digital, media, market research, production and other external agencies and consultants.
* Brief agencies on project requirements, review creative concepts and ensure timely delivery of campaigns and marketing materials.
* Evaluate agency outputs against agreed objectives, timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment on project positioning, communication and launch plans.
* Manage channel partner relationships from a marketing and communication perspective to support project visibility and lead generation.
* Ensure effective coordination across multiple stakeholders for seamless campaign and launch execution.
* Identify brand partnerships / associations which aid with product positioning across all media platforms, including on ground events.



  





**Digital Marketing \& Brand Management** 



* Work closely with Digital Marketing and Channel Sales teams to strengthen project and brand awareness.
* Drive development and enhancement of project websites, digital assets and online platforms.
* Support digital campaigns aimed at improving project visibility, lead generation, customer engagement and conversions.
* Ensure consistency of brand identity and communication across digital and offline touchpoints.
* Coordinate with PR, Corporate Communications and Events teams for project branding, media visibility and customer engagement initiatives.
* Identify relevant digital and content opportunities to enhance the overall customer journey and project experience.



  





**Budget \& Performance Management** 



* Develop and manage marketing budgets in line with project requirements and approved business plans.
* Monitor campaign expenditures and ensure effective utilization of marketing budgets.
* Track lead generation, campaign effectiveness, customer engagement, conversion and other relevant performance metrics by maintaining weekly / monthly product dashboards and reports to provide a comprehensive overview of marketing initiatives
* Prepare regular MIS, dashboards, performance reports and management presentations.
* Analyse marketing performance and recommend corrective actions and optimization opportunities.
* Identify process improvements and innovative approaches to improve marketing effectiveness and ROI.
* Work with procurement and finance teams to ensure timely issuing of purchase orders and payments to vendor partners.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Partner closely with Sales, Design, Projects, Digital Marketing, CRM, Corporate Communications, PR and Finance teams to achieve project objectives.
* Act as a key marketing interface between business and functional stakeholders for residential projects.
* Drive alignment on product positioning, customer proposition, campaign strategy and launch execution.
* Support strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing customer experience, brand differentiation and business growth.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination across teams throughout the product lifecycle.

**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and hands\-on Digital Marketing Specialist to lead our growth marketing efforts across organic, paid, social, and partnerships. This role is ideal for someone who has built and scaled growth engines in fast\-paced consumer internet businesses and has experience navigating both 0→1 and 1→10 growth journeys.
 



 You will own the end\-to\-end digital growth strategy with a strong focus on revenue, subscriptions, customer acquisition, and engagement. The role combines strategic leadership with hands\-on execution and team mentoring.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Growth \& Revenue** 



* Own digital growth goals across traffic, user acquisition, subscriptions, revenue, engagement.
* Develop and execute full\-funnel growth strategies across organic, paid, social, and partnerships.
* Identify and unlock new growth opportunities through experimentation, optimization, and data\-driven decision making.
* Drive customer acquisition while maintaining strong CAC, LTV, and ROI metrics.

* Lead the organization's organic growth strategy across traditional search and AI\-driven discovery platforms.

**Performance Marketing** 



* Own and optimize paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, Display, and other relevant channels.
* Manage budgets, attribution models, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and conversion optimization.
* Continuously improve campaign performance across CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and customer quality metrics.



**Social Media \& Content Growth** 



* Lead social media growth and engagement strategies across key platforms.
* Work closely with content, creative, product, and community teams to build compelling campaigns and drive brand visibility.
* Develop organic and paid social programs that contribute meaningfully to acquisition and retention goals.



**Analytics \& Growth Intelligence** 



* Establish robust measurement frameworks and growth dashboards.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel performance, retention cohorts, attribution, and campaign effectiveness.
* Generate actionable insights that influence product, content, and marketing decisions.
* Leverage analytics tools to identify growth opportunities and optimize conversion journeys.



**AI\-Driven Marketing** 



* Leverage AI tools and workflows to improve productivity, campaign performance, content creation, SEO, research, and marketing automation.
* Evaluate and implement emerging AI tools to create competitive advantages in marketing execution and customer acquisition.
* Drive experimentation with AI\-native marketing workflows and growth initiatives.



 ﻿
 



**What We're Looking For** 



* 5–7 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or performance marketing roles.
* Proven experience in a consumer\-facing internet, marketplace, SaaS, subscription, community, or digital platform business.
* Demonstrated success in scaling products through both early\-stage (0→1\) and growth\-stage (1→10\) journeys.
* Strong expertise in SEO, GEO, AEO, content\-led growth, and organic acquisition.
* Deep hands\-on experience managing Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid acquisition channels.
* Strong understanding of attribution, analytics, experimentation, conversion optimization, and growth frameworks.
* Experience using tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Mixpanel, Amplitude, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and similar platforms.
* Strong familiarity with AI tools including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI automation platforms, and AI\-powered marketing workflows.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment.



**Bonus Points** 



* Experience driving subscription growth and recurring revenue businesses.
* Experience building communities, content ecosystems, or network\-effect products.
* Experience marketing to professional audiences or digital consumer communities.
* Experience building AI\-first marketing workflows and teams.



**Success Metrics** 



* Revenue and subscription growth
* Organic traffic growth and AI\-search visibility
* Customer acquisition and CAC efficiency
* Paid marketing ROI and ROAS
* SEO/GEO/AEO performance improvements
* Conversion rate optimization across key funnels

title: Marketing Technologist, Web
description:
**About The Team**
 We are looking for an experienced Marketing Web Technologist to help build highly coordinated and efficient web integrations and infrastructure that powers Zillow's marketing organization. We serve as the technical liaison between marketing, product, engineering, and marketing vendor teams to bring all partners together toward a common goal. As part of the WebTech team, you will be responsible for building highly coordinated and efficient web integrations, infrastructure, and web platforms while playing a key role in the operations of the WebTech space; building new web components, managing configurations, integrations, and workflows to help with marketing needs. Participate in the onboarding and building of new platforms from implementation, integration, execution, data and security compliance review, and training user teams.
   

  

 This role leans heavily into hands\-on\-keyboard work, but also requires technical program management to work collaboratively across teams to deliver automation capabilities that empower our customers. The ideal candidate shines in a fast\-paced and ambiguous environment, and has a balance of technical web skills and program management. If you like solving complex problems and are passionate about enabling marketing teams and delivering the vision of Zillow 2\.0, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Drive the marketing web technology roadmap by participating in onboarding of new web platforms including requirements definition, implementation, integration, execution, testing and validation, data and security compliance review, and training of end user teams.
* Be involved in shaping MarTech web system design and help guide technical architecture discussions and decisions to establish a flexible, scalable, and secure tech stack.
* Understand web business requirements and identify data needs to enable marketing to deliver a personalized customer experience.
* Collaborate with teams across marketing, product, and engineering to develop detailed technical web project plans and align on roadmaps.
* Coordinate with other dev dependencies to align cross\-tech team sprint schedules \& release plans.
* You will assess risks, anticipate bottlenecks, provide critical issue management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, while balancing the business needs versus technical constraints.
* Beyond being successful, you’ll thrive if you relish crafting clarity from ambiguity (at a company level) and you take pride in driving complex cross\-team web programs while aligning to company and engineering strategy.
* Define and prioritize strategic web projects and shepherd them from concept to launch.
* Own and drive large and sophisticated web programs, while creating transparency through project plans that are focused on value realization, while collaborating with engineers to align teams and manage dependencies.
* Maintain and report on program status and seek to optimize timely delivery.
* Update leadership and the business on progress, issues, risk, and course correction plans.
* Drive AI adoption across Marketing Technology by identifying high\-impact use cases, implementing AI\-powered workflows, and using automation to improve team efficiency and free up time for higher\-value strategic work.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Have the ability to work with other engineering team’s code and systems to deliver new features that have impact across the company.
* You love driving cross\-functional, technical and sophisticated web programs to achieve business outcomes.
* An ability to take large, complex features, and break them down in deliverables that focus on value\-realization for the end user/customer.
* Improve management decision\-making by delivering data\-driven recommendations that are aligned with organizational strategy and quarterly goals.
* You are passionate about championing great work and advocate effectively on behalf of what’s best for the customer/user.
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem\-solve, scope technical requirements, and prioritize tasks.
* Highly effective communicator that enables you to earn trust at all levels and engage effectively with senior leaders.
* Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Gravitate toward the detail but can keep the big picture in focus.
* Highly analytical approach, using data to drive step\-change results.
* Exhibit a collaborative working style with a strong focus on execution and results.
* Have the modesty to question assumptions, seek broad input, and validate iteratively.
* Dedicated to operational excellence, clear communication, and take ownership of your work.
* You actively look for ways to use AI tools in your day\-to\-day work, experiment with new workflows, and are excited to dig in, learn, and iterate to make yourself and the team more efficient.


****Qualifications:****
* Bachelor's Degree in related field or relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of proven experience working in Marketing Technologies/Front End Engineering/Full\-Stack Engineering/Web Development in a technical setting, or similar role.
* Experience developing end\-to\-end applications including frontend UI (e.g., React/Next.js), backend services (e.g., Node/JavaScript), API integrations (e.g., REST/GraphQL), and working with modern data storage technologies (e.g., SQL/NoSQL databases).
* Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (AWS), working with containers (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and, ideally, infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
* Have experience developing/customizing WordPress themes and plugins and integrating WordPress as a headless CMS using modern frontend frameworks.
* Ability to think critically, be self\-motivated, and deal with ambiguity.
* Professional application of agile methodologies, specifically Scrum.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and experience interacting with both business and engineering individuals at all levels including the executive level.
* JIRA, Confluence, and g suite experience preferred.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
   

  

 As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
   

  

 Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

title: Product Marketing Growth
description:
**About Finrep:** 




 Finrep is building AI\-powered financial reporting for CFO teams at public and pre\-IPO companies. Finance, accounting, investor relations, and legal teams use us to get their SEC filings done faster: the 10\-K and 10\-Q (the annual and quarterly reports every US public company has to file), plus proxies, S\-1s, and 8\-Ks. Work that takes them hours today, like finding how other companies worded a similar disclosure, takes seconds with us.
 



  





**We are early, backed by Accel, and growing quickly.** 




  





**The Role:** 




 Our marketing systems already work. We are hiring you to push past them: open channels we have not tried, run growth experiments, and scale the ones that earn it.
 



  





**You will sit inside the GTM team and own product marketing and growth as one job:** 
 how we describe the product, where that description shows up, and whether it moves numbers. That covers positioning, LinkedIn, the blog, use case pages, paid experiments, and SEO. You get the current playbook to build on, and the freedom to break the parts that have stopped working.
 



 The range here is real. If your experiments land, GTM operations is yours to run.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**•** 
 Own Finrep's positioning: what we say we do, who we say it to, and how that shows up across every channel.
 



 • Write LinkedIn content that a technical accountant would actually stop for. This audience spots shallow content instantly, so every piece is grounded in real filings, FASB updates, or SEC comment letter data.
 



 • Run content and growth experiments across LinkedIn, Twitter, and YouTube. Set the hypothesis, ship it, read the numbers, kill what does not work.
 



 • Own paid experiments end to end: copy, creative, targeting, and the honest call on whether a channel deserves more budget.
 



 • Drive SEO enrichment: backlinks, affiliates, and partner outreach.
 



 • Write and optimise use case pages, blog posts, and landing pages for both search engines and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
 



 • Track competitors and turn the gaps in how they position themselves into angles we can own.
 



 • Grow the top of the funnel and scale whatever works.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 • Prior marketing experience with a portfolio or personal site we can read. Show us the work, not the job titles.
 



 • Product thinking. You can look at Finrep, work out what an SEC reporting lead is actually trying to get done that week, and write from there.
 



 • Basic engineering literacy. You know what a server does, roughly how a website is built and deployed, and you can read code without panicking. You will be shipping pages and wiring up tools yourself.
 



 • Fluency with AI and agentic tools such as Claude, Codex, and ChatGPT. You should already be building with them daily, not testing them on weekends.
 



 • Self\-direction. You see the gap, propose the experiment, and ship it without waiting for a brief.
 



 • Genuine excitement about a lean team where what you ship on Monday is live by Wednesday.
 



  





**Major Pluses:** 




 • Startup experience, especially at the early stage.
 



 • SEO, AEO, or GEO work you can point to and explain.
 



 • A track record of B2B content that earned real engagement from a professional audience.
 



 • Curiosity about finance, accounting, or regulation. You do not need domain knowledge on day one. You need the appetite to build it fast.
 



 • Comfort with Figma, Canva, Semrush, or HubSpot.
 



  





**What This Is Not:** 




 • Not a scheduling role. You create original content, not reposts and templates.
 



 • Not a role with a brief waiting for you every Monday. You propose the work.
 



 • Not a place to learn marketing from scratch. The team is small and the bar is practitioner grade.
 



  





**Why This Role:** 




  





 • You own the entire content and growth surface from day one: writing, web, paid, partnerships, and experimentation.
 



 • Direct access to the founders. Your ideas reach the decision table the same day.
 



 • A clear path to owning GTM operations if you perform.
 



 • A product solving a real, painful problem for an audience that rewards substance over flash.

title: Associate Marketing Manager, RBS Retail Efficiency
description:
**Description**
 Are you customer centric, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, entrepreneurial, and passionate about protecting brands? Do you want to be part of one of the fastest growing and most innovative brand protection businesses? Are you interested in a high impact, high ownership role that sits at the intersection of product authenticity, brand trust, and customer confidence? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. Come join our team and help define the course of Amazon's product authenticity and brand protection business.
   

  

 Amazon's vision is to be Earth's most customer\-centric company and the most trusted place for brands to grow and protect their business. We build programs and solutions that help brand owners verify product authenticity, secure their supply chain through serialization, and build customer trust — delighting millions of brands and customers every day.
   

  

 We are looking for a smart, metrics and results\-oriented Associate Manager \- Product Marketing to independently own our most important brand\-facing product authenticity initiatives — the "big rocks" that move the business. You will set the go\-to\-market and adoption roadmap for our product authenticity and serialization programs, build and scale marketing campaigns across the funnel, and define the dashboards and mechanisms that track enrollment, adoption, engagement, and retention.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Owning and driving the biggest, product marketing initiatives for brand protection and authenticity programs end to end — from strategy through execution and measurable business impact.
* Designing and scaling account\-based marketing (ABM) programs that target high\-value brands and segments with tailored, high\-touch messaging around supply chain integrity and anti\-counterfeiting solutions.
* Owning the full marketing funnel — awareness, lead generation, enrollment, activation, and retention — and independently driving conversion improvements at each stage.
* Building and scaling lifecycle and nurture programs (email, social, webinars, outbound, onboarding journeys) that move brands from awareness to active adoption of authenticity solutions.
* Leading go\-to\-market strategy for major new feature and program launches, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, and cross\-program placements.
* Defining the metrics, dashboards, and mechanisms used to measure program health (enrollment rates, serialization adoption, scan rates, brand engagement), and reporting performance and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Developing content and thought\-leadership strategies (case studies, playbooks, webinars, brand\-facing events) that drive awareness and enrollment at scale for product authenticity programs.
* Establishing best practices and reusable playbooks, and mentoring peers and junior team members to raise the bar across the org.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience in a marketing role


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with a Content Management System (e.g. Wordpress, Drupla, Joomla, etc.)
* Experience using integrated campaigns to solve brand/business challenges

 At Tally, we’re driven by one core mission \- making business simpler for everyone. As a pioneer in business management software, we have been the trusted partner of choice for \~3 million and 7\.5 million users across 100\+ countries \- many of them are MSMEs that form the backbone of global economies.
 



 Our journey is rooted in innovation, guided by deep empathy for customers, and driven by a commitment to excellence. With a legacy of trust and a future fueled by technology, we are shaping the way businesses manage accounting, inventory, compliance, and much more.
 



 We believe in honouring our people, nurturing potential, creating fearlessly, and mastering our craft \- all while staying true to our values. If you are looking to make a real impact, grow with purpose, and be part of something meaningful, you’ll find your place at Tally.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are working towards a larger ambition \- to become the technology backbone for global economic progress.
 



  





**About Marketing** 




 Marketing at Tally is a strategic, business\-enabling function that fuels innovation, builds consistency, and strengthens our market presence. Guided by our core pillars of like, Customer Connect, Integrated Marketing Digital and Brand Marketing, we craft initiatives that resonate with our audiences and reinforce our brand promise. We focus on creating impactful initiatives across Branding, Customer Marketing, and Partner Marketing to ensure strong engagement, lasting value and drive business growth.
 



  





 For us at Tally, brand marketing goes beyond visibility. It's about building trust, simplifying complexity, and championing businesses of all sizes. As India’s most loved business management software, Tally holds a unique position, one that blends deep legacy with contemporary relevance.
 



  





**Role:** 
 Manager \- Product Marketing
 



**Relevant Experience:** 
 5 to 8 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





 What You Will Own
 



  





 As a Product Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for driving deeper engagement, adoption, and value realization among our existing customer base. This is a customer\-first role sitting at the intersection of product marketing, customer success, content, and lifecycle marketing. You will translate product capabilities and customer insights into compelling content, stories, and campaigns that help customers unlock greater value from the product.
 



  





**Where Your Expertise Meets Our Future** 




 5\-8 years of experience in product marketing, customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, content marketing, or a related role.
 



 Strong experience marketing to an existing customer base.
 



 Excellent storytelling, content, and communication skills.
 



 Experience developing customer testimonials, case studies, videos, and success stories.
 



 Strong understanding of email, lifecycle, and mid\-funnel marketing.
 



 Ability to simplify products and turn features into compelling customer value.
 



 Strong customer interviewing and stakeholder management skills.
 



 Comfortable using data to measure and improve marketing effectiveness.
 



  





**The Scope of Your Influence** 




  





**Customer Storytelling \& Content** 




 Build a strong pipeline of customer testimonials, case studies, success stories, and videos.
 



 Identify compelling customer stories in partnership with Customer Success, Sales, and regional teams.
 



 Interview customers and turn their experiences, challenges, and outcomes into engaging stories.
 



 Develop content across videos, email, articles, use cases, and other formats.
 



 Build a library of customer proof points that can be used across marketing, sales, and customer communications.
 



  





**Customer Marketing \& Adoption** 




 Develop campaigns that drive adoption of products, features, and capabilities among existing customers.
 



 Translate product features into clear, relevant "why this matters to you" messaging.
 



 Identify customer needs, use cases, and adoption barriers, and build marketing programs around them.
 



 Create targeted communications for different customer segments and levels of product maturity.
 



  





**Mid\-Funnel \& Lifecycle Marketing** 




 Own customer\-facing communications and nurture programs that move customers from awareness to consideration and action.
 



 Build connected customer journeys rather than one\-off campaigns.
 



 Use customer stories and proof points to make communications more relevant and persuasive.
 



 Test and optimize messaging, content, and journeys based on performance.
 



  





**Cross\-functional \& Insights** 




 Partner closely with Product, Customer Success, Sales, Creative, and Analytics teams.
 



 Bring customer insights into product marketing and communications.
 



 Measure engagement, adoption, and campaign effectiveness, and continuously improve programs.

title: Product Marketing
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Marketing Specialist to drive the growth and market positioning of assigned business units. The candidate should be capable of working independently with Business Unit leaders to plan, execute, and track end\-to\-end marketing initiatives that strengthen both business growth and brand health. The role requires close collaboration with sales, product, and subject matter experts to deliver impactful go\-to\-market strategies, demand generation campaigns, and sales enablement programs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Build and execute GTM plans for products, solutions, and services aligned with business unit objectives, ensuring successful product launches and market adoption.
* Content Development: Create and manage high\-quality marketing and sales content, including brochures, presentations, solution briefs, case studies, emailers, campaign assets, website content, and thought leadership materials.
* Campaign Execution: Plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns across digital, email, webinars, events, social media, and partner channels to drive brand awareness, demand generation, and pipeline growth.
* Funnel Management: Own and monitor the end\-to\-end marketing funnel, tracking key conversion metrics from awareness to qualified pipeline. Work closely with sales teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and marketing contribution to revenue.
* Sales Enablement: Develop sales enablement assets such as pitch decks, battle cards, competitive positioning, solution briefs, and objection\-handling guides. Partner with sales teams to ensure they have the right messaging, content, and insights to accelerate deal closure.
* Win\-Loss Analysis: Conduct win\-loss analysis by gathering feedback from sales teams and customers to understand buying decisions, competitive dynamics, and market trends. Translate insights into actionable recommendations to refine product positioning, messaging, campaigns, and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Market Research: Conduct market research to understand customer needs, industry trends, analyst insights, and regulatory developments, enabling informed marketing and business decisions.
* Competitive Analysis: Continuously monitor competitor offerings, positioning, messaging, pricing, and go\-to\-market strategies to strengthen SISA's market differentiation.
* Marketing Performance \& Reporting: Track and analyze marketing KPIs, campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution, and ROI. Provide regular performance reports and recommend optimization strategies based on data\-driven insights.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with business units, product teams, sales, customer success, analysts, and subject matter experts to ensure alignment across product messaging, campaigns, customer engagement, and business objectives.

title: Marketing Programs Manager - Europe Strategic Market Unit
description:
Job description:
   

  

 About the role:
 
 This is an Enterprise\-focused B2B marketing position responsible for shaping and orchestrating impactful Marketing programs for the region, reporting directly to the Europe CMO. Proactively collaborating with stakeholders across the business to drive integrated programs aligned to ABM, Events, and Campaigns to enhance Wipro’s reputation in the market. 
   

 The role will focus primarily on collaborating with Wipro’s industry experts and Consulting Partners in Europe to supercharge priority client engagement with Wipro’s unified suite of AI\-powered platforms, solutions and transformative offerings.
 


 R͏esponsibilities:
 
 Orchestrate key marketing programs at a Pan\-Europe level in close collaboration with the Field Marketing leads across the region. Specifically:
 



 •    Partner with Wipro’s industry experts and Consulting leaders in Europe – To build and lead Consulting\-led, AI\-Powered, \& Industry\-focused market activation. Coordinate marketing resources to deliver relevant industry content and a joined\-up approach, feeding 1\-to\-1 and Industry cluster ABM.
   

 •    Planning and cross\-functional collaboration – Connect teams across Marketing to align resources behind a cohesive and coordinated outreach plan for Europe, targeting key clients and industries.
   

 •    Account\-based Marketing: Design 1\-2\-1 programs, capability, and content for local deployment to help shape and win large deals, with emphasis on initiatives that can be repeated and scaled.
   

 •    Large Industry events located in Europe: Support the Europe CMO to drive regional event activation to maximize global investment and client impact; to shape and enable the agreed plans working closely with the global event owners, Business owners, and the Field Marketing leads in the region, evaluate regional client impact and ensure swift follow\-up on leads generated.
   

 •    Campaign coordination and activation: Working across a matrix structure of Central Marketing and Field Marketing teams to design and execute impactful campaigns across a variety of channels. 
   

 •    Analyst \& Advisor collaboration: Support the Europe CMO to drive pan\-Europe A\&A initiatives in close collaboration with the Market Development team. Shape and deliver programs and capability centrally and for scale, designed for local activation/localization.
   

 •    Alliance Partner collaboration: Work proactively with Alliance Partner marketing colleagues and Wipro’s regional Partner leaders to build regional programs that attract MDF and can be rolled out across Europe to enhance our brand reputation and client outreach efforts.
   

 •    KPI Measurement \& Data Insights: Utilize analytics platforms working closely with the MarTech team to understand program impact and create dashboards/reports to interpret and visualize outcomes to guide others.
 


 E͏xperience:

The successful candidate will be a strong communicator and proactive collaborator, capable of leading teams and projects, and a track\-record of driving change and impact within the function. Specifically:
   

 •    Minimum 10 years’ B2B marketing experience, preferably working in IT Services, SaaS or Technology industries. Ideally with experience aligned to the Europe region.

 •    Excellent knowledge of marketing channels, technology and platforms, ideally Salesforce.com, Marketo, and 6Sense or similar.
   

 •    Good organizational skills, experience of working in a fast\-paced environment, and ability to effectively coordinate multiple stakeholders.
   

 •    Strong analytical skills with ability to highlight key insights in an impactful and simple way.
   

 •    High energy self\-starter with a can\-do attitude, and ability to learn quickly.
 


 ͏
 




 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions. 
 



 Applications from people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.

title: Manager - Content and Marketing
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a strategic and experienced communications and marketing leader to drive the media, content, communications and brand storytelling agenda for Inspire Institute of Sport (IIS). The role is responsible for shaping how IIS is positioned and represented across media, digital platforms, athlete storytelling, institutional communications and key sporting moments. The role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution, working closely with athletes, coaches, leadership, partners, donors, agencies and internal teams.
 



  





 The role will serve as a key custodian of the IIS brand narrative — defining what we say, how we say it, where we say it and how we build sustained visibility for IIS, its athletes, programmes and impact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Media, Communications \& Brand Strategy** 



* Develop and lead the annual media, communications and content strategy for IIS, aligned with organisational priorities, sporting calendars and long\-term brand objectives.
* Own IIS's external narrative across earned media, digital, social, institutional and stakeholder communications.
* Develop proactive media strategies around major sporting milestones, athlete achievements, institutional announcements and strategic initiatives.
* Build and maintain relationships with relevant national and sports media, publishers and other communication stakeholders.
* Lead communications around high\-profile sporting events, including the Commonwealth Games, Asian Games and LA 2028 journey.
* Identify and manage reputational and communications risks, including crisis and sensitive communications where required.



**2\. Content \& Storytelling** 



* Own the overall content strategy and editorial direction across IIS's digital and social ecosystem.
* Establish and maintain a consistent brand voice, tone and visual/editorial language across platforms.
* Develop content narratives around athletes, coaches, programmes, sporting achievements, institutional milestones and IIS's wider impact.
* Lead the ideation and execution of content across formats including video, social, long\-form storytelling, photography, graphics, web and editorial content.
* Plan and oversee content calendars around sporting events, athlete milestones, campaigns and institutional priorities.
* Work closely with creative teams, production partners, agencies and internal stakeholders to deliver high\-quality content.



**3\. Marketing \& Campaigns** 



* Develop and execute integrated marketing and communication campaigns to strengthen IIS's brand awareness and positioning.
* Lead content\-led launches and campaigns for new sports programmes, initiatives and IIS properties.
* Develop campaigns that translate IIS's athlete development and sporting impact into compelling public\-facing narratives.
* Oversee campaign planning, execution, measurement and optimisation across relevant channels.
* Identify opportunities to leverage major sporting events and cultural moments to increase IIS's visibility.



**4\. Athlete \& Sporting Communications** 



* Develop storytelling frameworks that bring IIS athlete journeys, performances and human\-interest stories to life.
* Lead communications and content planning around athletes participating in major international competitions.
* Work with coaches, programme managers and athlete support teams to identify stories, milestones and opportunities.
* Coordinate media opportunities, interviews, athlete features and other visibility initiatives.



**5\. Donor \& Stakeholder Communications** 



* Own the communications and content dimension of IIS donor relationships and partnerships.
* Develop brand\-integrated storytelling and campaigns that demonstrate the impact of donor support.
* Lead content inputs for donor communications, impact stories and the annual report/funding impact narrative.
* Work closely with leadership and internal stakeholders to ensure consistent messaging across institutional and external communications.



**6\. Agency, Team \& Budget Management** 



* Lead and manage an in\-house media/content team and external agency partners.
* Define agency scopes, identify/select partners, manage workflows and ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Provide strategic and creative direction to agencies across content, PR, digital, design, production and related requirements.
* Own and manage the annual marketing and communications budget, including planning, allocation and vendor management.
* Establish effective processes for prioritisation, approvals, production and delivery across multiple stakeholders.



**7\. Digital \& Owned Platforms** 



* Lead the content and communications strategy across IIS's owned digital platforms, including social media and website.
* Oversee the strategic development and evolution of the IIS digital ecosystem.
* Ensure the website and social platforms effectively communicate IIS's programmes, athletes, achievements and institutional impact.
* Track content and digital performance and use insights to inform future strategy.



**8\. Strategic Projects \& Brand Development** 



* Lead major brand and communications projects that strengthen IIS's long\-term positioning.
* Drive strategic initiatives such as website redevelopment, brand assets, institutional storytelling and the IIS Inspire Museum project.
* Coordinate multiple agencies, departments and senior stakeholders to deliver complex projects end\-to\-end.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the relationship between IIS, JSW Sports and the wider JSW ecosystem.



**9\. JSW Sports / Ecosystem Integration** 



* Collaborate across IIS and JSW Sports properties to identify opportunities for shared storytelling, audience development and brand amplification.
* Lead communications and content strategy for relevant cross\-property initiatives and partnerships.
* Provide strategic communications and content counsel to other JSW Sports properties where required.



**Key Requirements** 



* 10\+ years of experience in media, communications, content, marketing, brand or related roles, preferably within sports, media, entertainment or adjacent industries.
* Strong understanding of sports media, digital content, PR, brand storytelling and integrated communications.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic communication and marketing plans.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, vendors and significant budgets.
* Strong editorial judgement with the ability to turn complex institutional, sporting or athlete stories into compelling narratives.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders, athletes, coaches, partners, donors and media.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high\-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong understanding of social and digital platforms and evolving content formats.
* Ability to operate comfortably between strategy and execution in a fast\-paced sporting environment.
* Passion for sport and a strong understanding of the role that storytelling and communications play in building sports properties and athlete brands.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager** 




 Own Growth. Drive Visibility. Turn Traffic into Business.
 



  





**Salary Offered:** 
 8 LPA \- 10 LPA
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 For most customers, the journey with Zolo starts online. Whether someone is searching for co\-living, student housing, hotels, or short stays, search remains one of the most powerful acquisition channels available to the business. As Zolo continues to scale, we need a growth\-focused marketer who can ensure that customers discover us before they discover our competitors. This role exists to build and scale a predictable acquisition engine through SEO and Google Ads.
 



 A strong hire will help us:
 


* Increase qualified website traffic
* Improve search visibility across key categories
* Generate high\-quality leads at efficient costs
* Improve conversion from traffic to bookings
* Build sustainable growth beyond paid dependency



 If this role is strong, customer acquisition becomes scalable and measurable.
 



 If this role is weak, traffic stagnates, acquisition costs increase, and growth becomes inconsistent.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Own SEO performance across Zolo businesses
* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns end\-to\-end
* Drive growth in organic traffic and lead generation
* Improve conversion rates across landing pages and campaigns
* Maximize marketing ROI through continuous optimization
* Build a data\-driven growth engine through experimentation and analysis



 This is not a campaign execution role.
 



 It is end\-to\-end ownership of search visibility, paid acquisition performance, and growth outcomes.
 



  





**About Zolo** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**1\.Own SEO Growth** 



* Drive on\-page, off\-page, and technical SEO initiatives
* Improve keyword rankings across priority business categories
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis
* Identify opportunities to grow organic visibility and traffic
* Work closely with content, product, and technology teams to improve search performance



**2\.Own Google Ads Performance** 



* Manage Google Search, Display, and Performance Max campaigns
* Optimize campaigns for traffic, leads, and conversions
* Improve campaign efficiency and return on ad spend
* Monitor budgets, bidding strategies, and keyword performance
* Ensure continuous improvement in acquisition metrics



**3\.Drive Traffic\-to\-Conversion Performance** 



* Improve landing page performance and conversion rates
* Partner with design and product teams to optimize user journeys
* Run A/B tests and growth experiments
* Identify and remove conversion bottlenecks



**4\.Use Data to Drive Decisions** 



* Track traffic, lead generation, conversion, and acquisition metrics
* Monitor CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, and keyword performance
* Build performance dashboards and business insights
* Take decisions based on data rather than assumptions



**5\.Own Growth Experiments** 



* Identify new acquisition opportunities
* Test channels, landing pages, messaging, and audience strategies
* Scale successful experiments and eliminate low\-performing activities
* Continuously improve marketing efficiency



**6\. Stakeholder \& Agency Management** 



* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners
* Work with agencies, freelancers, and vendors where required
* Ensure alignment between marketing activities and business goals



**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 



* Significant improvement in organic traffic and keyword rankings
* Improved Google Ads efficiency and ROI
* Higher volume of qualified leads and bookings
* Reduced customer acquisition costs
* Strong reporting visibility across growth channels
* Consistent contribution to business growth through digital channels



 The role delivers predictable traffic, measurable growth, and efficient customer acquisition.
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You enjoy solving growth problems through data and experimentation
* You are comfortable owning outcomes, not just activities
* You think in traffic, leads, conversions, and revenue
* You enjoy identifying opportunities others miss
* You are analytical, curious, and execution\-focused
* You like continuously testing, learning, and improving performance



  





**Experience we value** 



* 2–5 years of experience in SEO, Performance Marketing, or Growth Marketing
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Ads
* Good understanding of technical SEO and search fundamentals
* Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager, and reporting tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Experience in startups, consumer internet, e\-commerce, travel, hospitality, or high\-growth businesses preferred



 A marketing degree is not mandatory.
 



 Strong execution capability, curiosity, and ownership matter more.
 



  





**The impact you will have** 



* You directly influence customer acquisition and business growth
* You help customers discover Zolo through search
* You improve marketing efficiency and ROI
* You build scalable growth channels that contribute to long\-term revenue growth



  





**Why join now** 




 Zolo is entering its next phase of growth across multiple business lines.
 



 Search and performance marketing will play a critical role in:
 


* Customer acquisition
* Revenue growth
* Brand visibility
* Long\-term scalability



 This role offers a direct path toward Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing Leadership, and broader Business Growth roles.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**Head of Marketing** 




**Location** 
 : Bengaluru,India
 



 Reports to the Chief Product Officer
 



  





**About Deep Cognition** 




 Deep Cognition builds AI automation for freight forwarding and customs brokerage. Freight forwarding runs on people and paperwork. We build the AI that handles the repetitive work so teams can focus on customers.We have two products. Agentic TMS is a transportation management system run by AI agents. The agents handle quoting, booking, customs filing, and invoicing across the shipment lifecycle. PaperEntry AI is intelligent document processing. It reads commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and customs entries with 99 percent or better accuracy. Together they let a forwarder or broker move 5 to 10 times more volume with the same team.Our customers include C.H. Robinson, Maersk, JAS Worldwide, Dachser, and Rohlig Logistics. We process over $1 billion in goods each year.
 



 We are an early stage company with a small, fast team. Our headquarters is in Dallas, Texas. Our engineering and marketing teams are in Bengaluru. Our customers are in the US, Canada, Europe, and Asia.
 



  





**The role :** 




 We are hiring a Head of Marketing to own our pipeline. You will report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently leads marketing. Your job is simple to state. Grow the number of qualified leads. Turn those leads into sales meetings. Make our brand the one forwarders and brokers think of when they think about AI for logistics. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the strategy. You will also run campaigns yourself. You will manage a small in house team and a bench of external contractors and agencies.
 



  





**What we are looking for :** 



* 8 or more years in B2B marketing. At least 3 years leading a team or a function.
* Experience at an early stage startup. You have built marketing from a small base with a small budget.
* A track record of growing pipeline. You can show the numbers.
* Experience managing external contractors and agencies. You know how to brief, measure, and replace vendors.
* Strong writing. You can produce a clear email, landing page, or one pager without an agency.
* Comfort with data. You know your cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline sources.
* Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate. Hybrid work from our Bengaluru office.
* Able to work with a US based leadership team. Some evening calls each week.



  





**What you will do :** 



* Own the lead pipeline target. Report on it weekly.
* Run demand generation across email outbound, LinkedIn, paid search, SEO, webinars, and trade shows.
* Build and manage the marketing tech stack.
* Manage external contractors for content, design, video, paid media and appointment setting. Set clear briefs. Hold them to results.
* Write and edit content that speaks to freight forwarders and customs brokers. Cover both Agentic TMS and PaperEntry AI.
* Plan our conference and trade show calendar. Run our presence at events.
* Work with Sales on lead handoff, follow up, and conversion.
* Work with Product on positioning, launches, and customer stories.
* Own our website and our presence on review and analyst sites.
* Hire and coach a small marketing team as we grow.



  





**It would be great if you have :** 



* Logistics, freight, customs, or supply chain industry experience. This is our ideal profile.
* Experience marketing to US and European buyers from India.
* Experience marketing AI agents, TMS, or document automation products.
* Experience with outbound prospecting and sales engagement tools.



  





**Why join :** 



* Own the marketing function end to end. Report directly to the leadership team.
* Two products customers love. Our users save hours every day.
* A real market. Logistics is a multi trillion dollar industry that still runs on paper.
* Hybrid flexibility. Work from home part of the week.
* Competitive salary.

 **Marketing Manager** 
 to join our dynamic team.

**Role Title:** 
 Marketing Manager \- India
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time, Permanent
   

  

**Language Requirements:**

 As the
 **Marketing Manager for India** 
 , you will be the commercial catalyst for our region. Sitting within the APAC Demand Generation team and reporting to the Senior Director of Demand Generation (APAC), you will be responsible for developing and implementing end\-to\-end marketing strategies that generate high\-quality leads and drive revenue for the Indian business.
   

  

 We are looking for a marketing leader who bridges the gap between strategy and execution. You will act as the vital linchpin between the India Sales Leadership team and our global/regional marketing functions, seamlessly adapting global frameworks into highly impactful, hyper\-localized programs that resonate with Indian IT leaders and decision\-makers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 As the Marketing Manager for India, you will take ownership of the regional marketing roadmap, orchestrating campaigns that build our brand and directly fill the sales pipeline.
   

  

* Strategic Planning \& Alignment: Build and own the comprehensive regional marketing plan. Collaborate deeply with the APAC Demand Gen leader and the India Regional Vice President to align marketing initiatives with core business goals and sales priorities.
* Multi\-Channel Campaign Execution: Design and implement persona\- and industry\-specific campaigns. Orchestrate a diverse mix of tactics including physical and digital events, executive roundtables, Account\-Based Marketing (ABM), email nurtures, and community marketing.
* Localization \& Global Synergy: Work in tandem with global program teams to execute the "local flavor" of global campaigns. Localize messaging, digital properties (website, landing pages), and assets to optimize SEO/AEO for the Indian market.
* Partner \& Ecosystem Marketing: Collaborate closely with regional Partner Managers to increase local brand awareness, drive joint partner pipeline, and support partner enablement through tailored campaign toolkits.
* Budget \& ROI Management: Take full ownership of the regional field and partner marketing budget. Rigorously track program spending, assess campaign effectiveness, and continuously optimize for maximum Return on Investment (ROI).
